chapters.title: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الدُّنْيَا سِجْنُ الْمُؤْمِنِ وَجَنَّةُ الْكَافِرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alddunyaa sijnu almuumini wajannaau alkaafiri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The world is a prison-house for a believer and Paradise for a non-believer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ بِالسُّوقِ دَاخِلاً مِنْ بَعْضِ الْعَالِيَةِ وَالنَّاسُ كَنَفَتَهُ فَمَرَّ بِجَدْىٍ أَسَكَّ مَيِّتٍ فَتَنَاوَلَهُ فَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُّكُمْ يُحِبُّ أَنَّ هَذَا لَهُ بِدِرْهَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا مَا نُحِبُّ أَنَّهُ لَنَا بِشَىْءٍ وَمَا نَصْنَعُ بِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَتُحِبُّونَ أَنَّهُ لَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَاللَّهِ لَوْ كَانَ حَيًّا كَانَ عَيْبًا فِيهِ لأَنَّهُ أَسَكُّ فَكَيْفَ وَهُوَ مَيِّتٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ فَوَاللَّهِ لَلدُّنْيَا أَهْوَنُ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ هَذَا عَلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - ya'niy abna bilaalin - 'an ja'farin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm marra bialssuwqi daakhilaan min ba'di al'aaliyaai waalnnaasu kanafatahu famarra bijadain aasakka mayyitin fatanaawalahu faaakhadha biaudhunihi thumma qaala ‏"‏ aayyukum yuhibbu aanna hadhaa lahu bidirhamin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa maa nuhibbu aannahu lanaa bishaa'in wamaa nasna'u bihi qaala ‏"‏ aatuhibbuwna aannahu lakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa waalllahi law kaana hayyana kaana 'aybana fiyhi laannahu aasakku fakayfa wahuwa mayyitun faqaala ‏"‏ fawaalllahi lalddunyaa aahwanu 'alaa alllahi min hadhaa 'alaykum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) happened to walk through the bazar coming from the side of 'Aliya and the people were on both his sides. There he found a dead lamb with very short ears. He took hold of his ear and said:Who amongst you would like to have this for a dirham? They said: We do not like to have it even for less than that as it is of no use to us. He said: Do you wish to have it (free of any cost)? They said: By Allah, even if it were alive (we would not have liked to possess that), for there is defect in it as its ear is very short; now it is dead also. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: By Allah, this world is more insignificant in the eye of Allah than it (this dead lamb) is in your eye
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَرْعَرَةَ السَّامِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِيَانِ الثَّقَفِيَّ - عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ الثَّقَفِيِّ فَلَوْ كَانَ حَيًّا كَانَ هَذَا السَّكَكُ بِهِ عَيْبًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa al'anaziyyu, waiibraahiymu bnu muhammadi bni 'ar'araaa alssaamiyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, - ya'niyaani althhaqafiyya - 'an ja'farin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi althhaqafiyyi falaw kaana hayyana kaana hadhaa alssakaku bihi 'aybana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) narrating a hadith like this with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏ أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ‏}‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَقُولُ ابْنُ آدَمَ مَالِي مَالِي - قَالَ - وَهَلْ لَكَ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ مِنْ مَالِكَ إِلاَّ مَا أَكَلْتَ فَأَفْنَيْتَ أَوْ لَبِسْتَ فَأَبْلَيْتَ أَوْ تَصَدَّقْتَ فَأَمْضَيْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an mutarrifin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yaqraau ‏{‏ aalhaakumu alttakaathuru‏}‏ qaala ‏ "‏ yaquwlu abnu adama maaliy maaliy - qaala - wahal laka yaa abna adama min maalika iilaaa maa aakalta faaafnayta aaw labista faaablayta aaw tasaddaqta faaamdayta ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mutarrif reported on the authority of his father:I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as he was reciting:" Abundance diverts you" (cii. 1). He said: The son of Adam claims: My wealth, my wealth. And he (the Holy Prophet) said: O son of Adam. is there anything as your belonging except that which you consumed, which you utilised, or which you wore and then it was worn out or you gave as charity and sent it forward?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، وَقَالاَ، جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي كُلُّهُمْ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ انْتَهَيْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ هَمَّامٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, waqaalaa, jamiy'ana haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an sa'iydin, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathanaa aabiy kulluhum, 'an qataadaaa, 'an mutarrifin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala antahaytu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithli hadiythi hammaamin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mutarrif reported on the authority of his father:I went to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَقُولُ الْعَبْدُ مَالِي مَالِي إِنَّمَا لَهُ مِنْ مَالِهِ ثَلاَثٌ مَا أَكَلَ فَأَفْنَى أَوْ لَبِسَ فَأَبْلَى أَوْ أَعْطَى فَاقْتَنَى وَمَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ فَهُوَ ذَاهِبٌ وَتَارِكُهُ لِلنَّاسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hafsu bnu maysaraaa, 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yaquwlu al'abdu maaliy maaliy iinnamaa lahu min maalihi thalaathun maa aakala faaafnaa aaw labisa faaablaa aaw aa'taa faaqtanaa wamaa siwaa dhalika fahuwa dhaahibun wataarikuhu lilnnaasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A servant says, My wealth. my wealth, but out of his wealth three things are only his: whatever he eats and makes use of or by means of which he dresses himself and it wears out or he gives as charity, and this is what he stored for himself (as a reward for the Hereafter), and what is beyond this (it is of no use to you) because you are to depart and leave it for other people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْعَلاَءُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, aakhbaranaa abnu aabiy maryama, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, aakhbaraniy al'alaa'u bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of al-'Ala' b. 'Abd al-Rahman with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَتْبَعُ الْمَيِّتَ ثَلاَثَةٌ فَيَرْجِعُ اثْنَانِ وَيَبْقَى وَاحِدٌ يَتْبَعُهُ أَهْلُهُ وَمَالُهُ وَعَمَلُهُ فَيَرْجِعُ أَهْلُهُ وَمَالُهُ وَيَبْقَى عَمَلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, kilaahumaa 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yatba'u almayyita thalaathaaun fayarji'u athnaani wayabqaa waahidun yatba'uhu aahluhu wamaaluhu wa'amaluhu fayarji'u aahluhu wamaaluhu wayabqaa 'amaluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Three things follow the bier of a dead man. Two of them come back and one is left with him: the members of his family, wealth and his good deeds. The members of his family and wealth come back and the deeds alone are left with him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَرْمَلَةَ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ التُّجِيبِيَّ - أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ الْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ عَوْفٍ وَهُوَ حَلِيفُ بَنِي عَامِرِ بْنِ لُؤَىٍّ وَكَانَ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ الْجَرَّاحِ إِلَى الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَأْتِي بِجِزْيَتِهَا وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هُوَ صَالَحَ أَهْلَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعَلاَءَ بْنَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ فَقَدِمَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بِمَالٍ مِنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ فَسَمِعَتِ الأَنْصَارُ بِقُدُومِ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ فَوَافَوْا صَلاَةَ الْفَجْرِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم انْصَرَفَ فَتَعَرَّضُوا لَهُ فَتَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ رَآهُمْ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَظُنُّكُمْ سَمِعْتُمْ أَنَّ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ قَدِمَ بِشَىْءٍ مِنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا أَجَلْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ ‏"‏ فَأَبْشِرُوا وَأَمِّلُوا مَا يَسُرُّكُمْ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا الْفَقْرَ أَخْشَى عَلَيْكُمْ ‏.‏ وَلَكِنِّي أَخْشَى عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تُبْسَطَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَا بُسِطَتْ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ فَتَنَافَسُوهَا كَمَا تَنَافَسُوهَا وَتُهْلِكَكُمْ كَمَا أَهْلَكَتْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa bni 'abdi alllahi, - ya'niy abna harmalaaa bni 'imraana alttujiybiyya - aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, aanna almiswara bna makhramaaa, aakhbarahu aanna 'amraw bna 'awfin wahuwa haliyfu baniy 'aamiri bni luuaaain wakaana shahida badrana ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha aabaa 'ubaydaaa bna aljarraahi iilaa albahrayni yaatiy bijizyatihaa wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm huwa saalaha aahla albahrayni waaammara 'alayhimu al'alaa'a bna alhadramiyyi faqadima aabuw 'ubaydaaa bimaalin mina albahrayni fasami'ati alaansaaru biquduwmi aabiy 'ubaydaaa fawaafawa salaaaa alfajri ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ansarafa fata'arraduwa lahu fatabassama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna raahum thumma qaala ‏"‏ aazunnukum sami'tum aanna aabaa 'ubaydaaa qadima bishaa'in mina albahrayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa aajal yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ ‏"‏ faaabshiruwa waaammiluwa maa yasurrukum fawaalllahi maa alfaqra aakhshaa 'alaykum ‏.‏ walakinniy aakhshaa 'alaykum aan tubsata alddunyaa 'alaykum kamaa busitat 'alaa man kaana qablakum fatanaafasuwhaa kamaa tanaafasuwhaa watuhlikakum kamaa aahlakathum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amr b. `Auf, who was an ally of Banu `Amir b. Luwayy (and he was one amongst them) who participated in Badr along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reported that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent Abu `Ubaida b. Al-Jarrah to Bahrain for collecting Jizya and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made a truce with the people of Bahrain and had appointed `Ala' b. Hadrami and Abu `Ubaida (for this purpose). They came with wealth from Bahrain and the Ansar heard about the arrival of Abu `Ubaida and they had observed the dawn prayer along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished the prayer, they (the Ansar) came before him and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled as he saw them and then said:I think you have heard about the arrival of Abu `Ubaida with goods from Bahrain. They said: Allah's Messenger, yes, it is so. Thereupon he said: Be happy and be hopeful of that which gives you delight. By Allah, it is not the poverty about which I fear in regard to you but I am afraid in your case that (the worldly) riches way be given to you as were given to those who had gone before you and you begin to vie with one another for them as they vied for them, and these may destroy you as these destroyed them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بْنِ سَعْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِإِسْنَادِ يُونُسَ وَمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ صَالِحٍ ‏ "‏ وَتُلْهِيَكُمْ كَمَا أَلْهَتْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, jamiy'ana 'an ya'quwba bni iibraahiyma, bni sa'din haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, biiisnaadi yuwnusa wamithli hadiythihi ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi saalihin ‏ "‏ watulhiyakum kamaa aalhathum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri as reported by Yunus with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ الْعَامِرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ، الْحَارِثِ أَنَّ بَكْرَ بْنَ سَوَادَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ يَزِيدَ بْنَ رَبَاحٍ - هُوَ أَبُو فِرَاسٍ مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ - حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ فَارِسُ وَالرُّومُ أَىُّ قَوْمٍ أَنْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ نَقُولُ كَمَا أَمَرَنَا اللَّهُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوْ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ تَتَنَافَسُونَ ثُمَّ تَتَحَاسَدُونَ ثُمَّ تَتَدَابَرُونَ ثُمَّ تَتَبَاغَضُونَ أَوْ نَحْوَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ تَنْطَلِقُونَ فِي مَسَاكِينِ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ فَتَجْعَلُونَ بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَى رِقَابِ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu sawwaadin al'aamiriyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu, alhaarithi aanna bakra bna sawaadaaa, haddathahu aanna yaziyda bna rabaahin - huwa aabuw firaasin mawlaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'amriw bni al'aasi - haddathahu 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amriw bni al'aasi, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏"‏ iidhaa futihat 'alaykum faarisu waalrruwmu aaaau qawmin aantum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'awfin naquwlu kamaa aamaranaa alllahu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaw ghayra dhalika tatanaafasuwna thumma tatahaasaduwna thumma tatadaabaruwna thumma tatabaaghaduwna aaw nahwa dhalika thumma tantaliquwna fiy masaakiyni almuhaajiriyna fataj'aluwna ba'dahum 'alaa riqaabi ba'din ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. `Amr b. al-`As reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:How would you be, O people, when Persia and Rome would be conquered for you? `Abd ar-Rahman b `Auf said: We would say as Allah has commanded us and we would express our gratitude to Allah. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Nothing else besides it? You would (in fact) vie with one another, then you would feel jealous, then your relations would be estranged and then you will bear enmity against one another, or something to the same effect. Then you would go to the poor emigrants and would make some the masters of the others
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِزَامِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا نَظَرَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى مَنْ فُضِّلَ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْخَلْقِ فَلْيَنْظُرْ إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ أَسْفَلَ مِنْهُ مِمَّنْ فُضِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala qutaybaau haddathanaa waqaala, yahyaa aakhbaranaa almughiyraau bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alhizaamiyyu, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa nazara aahadukum iilaa man fuddila 'alayhi fiy almaali waalkhalqi falyanzur iilaa man huwa aasfala minhu mimman fuddila 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:When one of you looks at one who stands at a higher level than you in regard to wealth and physical structure he should also see one who stands at a lower level than you in regard to these things (in which he stands) at a higher level (as compared to him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ سَوَاءً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi aabiy alzzinaadi sawaa'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ انْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَلاَ تَنْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ فَوْقَكُمْ فَهُوَ أَجْدَرُ أَنْ لاَ تَزْدَرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏"‏ عَلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, wawakiy'un, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ anzuruwa iilaa man aasfala minkum walaa tanzuruwa iilaa man huwa fawqakum fahuwa aajdaru aan laa tazdaruwa ni'maaa alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw mu'aawiyaaa ‏"‏ 'alaykum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Look at those who stand at a lower level than you but don't look at those who stand at a higher level than you, for that is better-suited that you do not disparage Allah's favors. In the chain narrated by Abu Mu'awiya's he said: Upon you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ ثَلاَثَةً فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَبْرَصَ وَأَقْرَعَ وَأَعْمَى فَأَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَبْتَلِيَهُمْ فَبَعَثَ إِلَيْهِمْ مَلَكًا فَأَتَى الأَبْرَصَ فَقَالَ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ لَوْنٌ حَسَنٌ وَجِلْدٌ حَسَنٌ وَيَذْهَبُ عَنِّي الَّذِي قَدْ قَذِرَنِي النَّاسُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَسَحَهُ فَذَهَبَ عَنْهُ قَذَرُهُ وَأُعْطِيَ لَوْنًا حَسَنًا وَجِلْدًا حَسَنًا قَالَ فَأَىُّ الْمَالِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ الإِبِلُ - أَوْ قَالَ الْبَقَرُ شَكَّ إِسْحَاقُ - إِلاَّ أَنَّ الأَبْرَصَ أَوِ الأَقْرَعَ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا الإِبِلُ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ الْبَقَرُ - قَالَ فَأُعْطِيَ نَاقَةً عُشَرَاءَ فَقَالَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِيهَا - قَالَ - فَأَتَى الأَقْرَعَ فَقَالَ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ شَعَرٌ حَسَنٌ وَيَذْهَبُ عَنِّي هَذَا الَّذِي قَذِرَنِي النَّاسُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَسَحَهُ فَذَهَبَ عَنْهُ وَأُعْطِيَ شَعَرًا حَسَنًا - قَالَ - فَأَىُّ الْمَالِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ الْبَقَرُ ‏.‏ فَأُعْطِيَ بَقَرَةً حَامِلاً فَقَالَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِيهَا - قَالَ - فَأَتَى الأَعْمَى فَقَالَ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ أَنْ يَرُدَّ اللَّهُ إِلَىَّ بَصَرِي فَأُبْصِرَ بِهِ النَّاسَ - قَالَ - فَمَسَحَهُ فَرَدَّ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ بَصَرَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَىُّ الْمَالِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ الْغَنَمُ ‏.‏ فَأُعْطِيَ شَاةً وَالِدًا فَأُنْتِجَ هَذَانِ وَوَلَّدَ هَذَا - قَالَ - فَكَانَ لِهَذَا وَادٍ مِنَ الإِبِلِ وَلِهَذَا وَادٍ مِنَ الْبَقَرِ وَلِهَذَا وَادٍ مِنَ الْغَنَمِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ أَتَى الأَبْرَصَ فِي صُورَتِهِ وَهَيْئَتِهِ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِسْكِينٌ قَدِ انْقَطَعَتْ بِيَ الْحِبَالُ فِي سَفَرِي فَلاَ بَلاَغَ لِيَ الْيَوْمَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ثُمَّ بِكَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِالَّذِي أَعْطَاكَ اللَّوْنَ الْحَسَنَ وَالْجِلْدَ الْحَسَنَ وَالْمَالَ بَعِيرًا أَتَبَلَّغُ عَلَيْهِ فِي سَفَرِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْحُقُوقُ كَثِيرَةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ كَأَنِّي أَعْرِفُكَ أَلَمْ تَكُنْ أَبْرَصَ يَقْذَرُكَ النَّاسُ فَقِيرًا فَأَعْطَاكَ اللَّهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا وَرِثْتُ هَذَا الْمَالَ كَابِرًا عَنْ كَابِرٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنْ كُنْتَ كَاذِبًا فَصَيَّرَكَ اللَّهُ إِلَى مَا كُنْتَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَتَى الأَقْرَعَ فِي صُورَتِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ لِهَذَا وَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ مِثْلَ مَا رَدَّ عَلَى هَذَا فَقَالَ إِنْ كُنْتَ كَاذِبًا فَصَيَّرَكَ اللَّهُ إِلَى مَا كُنْتَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَتَى الأَعْمَى فِي صُورَتِهِ وَهَيْئَتِهِ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِسْكِينٌ وَابْنُ سَبِيلٍ انْقَطَعَتْ بِيَ الْحِبَالُ فِي سَفَرِي فَلاَ بَلاَغَ لِيَ الْيَوْمَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ثُمَّ بِكَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِالَّذِي رَدَّ عَلَيْكَ بَصَرَكَ شَاةً أَتَبَلَّغُ بِهَا فِي سَفَرِي فَقَالَ قَدْ كُنْتُ أَعْمَى فَرَدَّ اللَّهُ إِلَىَّ بَصَرِي فَخُذْ مَا شِئْتَ وَدَعْ مَا شِئْتَ فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ أَجْهَدُكَ الْيَوْمَ شَيْئًا أَخَذْتَهُ لِلَّهِ فَقَالَ أَمْسِكْ مَالَكَ فَإِنَّمَا ابْتُلِيتُمْ فَقَدْ رُضِيَ عَنْكَ وَسُخِطَ عَلَى صَاحِبَيْكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu aabiy 'amraaa, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, haddathahu aannahu, sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ iinna thalaathaaan fiy baniy iisraaiiyla aabrasa waaaqra'a waaa'maa faaaraada alllahu aan yabtaliyahum faba'atha iilayhim malakana faaataa alaabrasa faqaala aaaau shaa'in aahabbu iilayka qaala lawnun hasanun wajildun hasanun wayadhhabu 'anniy alladhiy qad qadhiraniy alnnaasu ‏.‏ qaala famasahahu fadhahaba 'anhu qadharuhu waau'tiya lawnana hasanana wajildana hasanana qaala faaaaau almaali aahabbu iilayka qaala aliibilu - aaw qaala albaqaru shakka iishaaqu - iilaaa aanna alaabrasa aawi alaaqra'a qaala aahaduhumaa aliibilu waqaala alakharu albaqaru - qaala faau'tiya naaqaaan 'usharaa'a faqaala baaraka alllahu laka fiyhaa - qaala - faaataa alaaqra'a faqaala aaaau shaa'in aahabbu iilayka qaala sha'arun hasanun wayadhhabu 'anniy hadhaa alladhiy qadhiraniy alnnaasu ‏.‏ qaala famasahahu fadhahaba 'anhu waau'tiya sha'arana hasanana - qaala - faaaaau almaali aahabbu iilayka qaala albaqaru ‏.‏ faau'tiya baqaraaan haamilaan faqaala baaraka alllahu laka fiyhaa - qaala - faaataa alaa'maa faqaala aaaau shaa'in aahabbu iilayka qaala aan yarudda alllahu iilaaaa basariy faaubsira bihi alnnaasa - qaala - famasahahu faradda alllahu iilayhi basarahu ‏.‏ qaala faaaaau almaali aahabbu iilayka qaala alghanamu ‏.‏ faau'tiya shaaaan waalidana faauntija hadhaani wawallada hadhaa - qaala - fakaana lihadhaa waadin mina aliibili walihadhaa waadin mina albaqari walihadhaa waadin mina alghanami ‏.‏ qaala thumma iinnahu aataa alaabrasa fiy suwratihi wahayiatihi faqaala rajulun miskiynun qadi anqata'at biya alhibaalu fiy safariy falaa balaagha liya alyawma iilaaa bialllahi thumma bika aasaaluka bialladhiy aa'taaka alllawna alhasana waaljilda alhasana waalmaala ba'iyrana aataballaghu 'alayhi fiy safariy ‏.‏ faqaala alhuquwqu kathiyraaun ‏.‏ faqaala lahu kaaanniy aa'rifuka aalam takun aabrasa yaqdharuka alnnaasu faqiyrana faaa'taaka alllahu faqaala iinnamaa warithtu hadhaa almaala kaabirana 'an kaabirin ‏.‏ faqaala iin kunta kaadhibana fasayyaraka alllahu iilaa maa kunta ‏.‏ qaala waaataa alaaqra'a fiy suwratihi faqaala lahu mithla maa qaala lihadhaa waradda 'alayhi mithla maa radda 'alaa hadhaa faqaala iin kunta kaadhibana fasayyaraka alllahu iilaa maa kunta ‏.‏ qaala waaataa alaa'maa fiy suwratihi wahayiatihi faqaala rajulun miskiynun waabnu sabiylin anqata'at biya alhibaalu fiy safariy falaa balaagha liya alyawma iilaaa bialllahi thumma bika aasaaluka bialladhiy radda 'alayka basaraka shaaaan aataballaghu bihaa fiy safariy faqaala qad kuntu aa'maa faradda alllahu iilaaaa basariy fakhudh maa shiita wada' maa shiita fawaalllahi laa aajhaduka alyawma shayiana aakhadhtahu lillahi faqaala aamsik maalaka faiinnamaa abtuliytum faqad rudiya 'anka wasukhita 'alaa saahibayka ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira, narrated that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There were three persons in Bani Isra'il, one suffering from leprosy, the other bald-headed and the third one blind. Allah decided to test them. So He sent an angel who came to the one who was suffering from leprosy and said: Which thing do you like most? He said: Beautiful colour and fine skin and removal of that which makes me detestable in the eye of people. He wiped him and his illness was no more and he was conferred upon beautiful colour and beautiful skin. He (the angel) again said: Which property do you like most? He said: Camels, or he said: The cow the narrator is, however, doubtful about it, but (out of the persons) suffering from leprosy or baldness one of them definitely said: The camel. And the other one said: Cow. And he (one who demanded camel) was bestowed upon a she-camel, in an advanced stage of pregnancy, and while giving he said: May Allah bless you in this. Then he came to the bald-headed person and said: Which thing do you like most? He said: Beautiful hair and that (this baldness) may be removed from me because of which people hate me. He wiped his body and his illness was removed and he was bestowed upon beautiful hair, and the angel said: Which wealth do you like most? He said: The cow. And he was given a pregnant cow and while handing it over to him he (the angel) said: May Allah bless you in this. Then he came to the blind man and he said: Which thing do you like most? He said: Allah should restore my eyesight so that I should be able to see people with the help of that. He wiped his body and Allah restored to him his eyesight, and he (the angel) also said: Which wealth do you like most? He said: The flock of sheep. And he was given a pregnant goat and that gave birth to young ones and it so happened that one valley abounded in camels and the other one in cows and the third one in sheep. He then came to the one who had suffered from leprosy in his (old) form and shape and he said: I am a poor person and my provision has run short in my journey and there is none to take me to my destination except with the help of Allah and your favour. I beg of you in His name Who gave you fine colour and fine skin, and the camel in the shape of wealth (to confer upon me) a camel which should carry me in my journey. He said: I have many responsibilities to discharge. Thereupon he said: I perceive as if I recognise you. Were you not suffering from leprosy whom people hated and you were a destitute and Allah conferred upon you (wealth)? He said: I have inherited this property from my forefathers. Thereupon he said: If you are a liar may Allah change you to that very position in which you had been. He then came to the one who was bald-headed in his (old) form and said to him the same what he had said to him (one suffering from leprosy) and he gave him the same reply as he had given him and he said: If you are a liar, may Allah turn you to your previous position in which you had been. And then he came to the blind man in his (old) form and shape and he said: I am a destitute person and a wayfarer. My provision have ran short and today there is no way to reach the destination but with the help of Allah and then with your help and I beg of you in the (name) of One Who restored your eyesight and gave you the flock of sheep to give me a sheep by which I should be able to make my provisions for the journey. He said: I was blind and Allah restored to me my eyesight; you take whatever you like and leave whatever you like. By Allah, I shall not stand in your way today for what you take in the name of God. Thereupon, he said: You keep with you what you have (in your possession). The fact is that you three were put to test and Allah is well pleased with you and He is annoyed with your companions
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لإِسْحَاقَ - قَالَ عَبَّاسٌ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا - أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بُكَيْرُ بْنُ مِسْمَارٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ كَانَ سَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ فِي إِبِلِهِ فَجَاءَهُ ابْنُهُ عُمَرُ فَلَمَّا رَآهُ سَعْدٌ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذَا الرَّاكِبِ فَنَزَلَ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَنَزَلْتَ فِي إِبِلِكَ وَغَنَمِكَ وَتَرَكْتَ النَّاسَ يَتَنَازَعُونَ الْمُلْكَ بَيْنَهُمْ فَضَرَبَ سَعْدٌ فِي صَدْرِهِ فَقَالَ اسْكُتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ التَّقِيَّ الْغَنِيَّ الْخَفِيَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abbaasu bnu 'abdi al'aziymi, - waalllafzu liishaaqa - qaala 'abbaasun haddathanaa waqaala, iishaaqu aakhbaranaa - aabuw bakrin alhanafiyyu, haddathanaa bukayru bnu mismaarin, haddathaniy 'aamiru bnu sa'din, qaala kaana sa'du bnu aabiy waqqaasin fiy iibilihi fajaa'ahu abnuhu 'umaru falammaa raahu sa'dun qaala aa'uwdhu bialllahi min sharri hadhaa alrraakibi fanazala faqaala lahu aanazalta fiy iibilika waghanamika watarakta alnnaasa yatanaaza'uwna almulka baynahum fadaraba sa'dun fiy sadrihi faqaala askut sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha yuhibbu al'abda alttaqiyya alghaniyya alkhafiyya ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Amir b. Sa'd that Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas was in the fold of his camels that his son 'Umar came to him. When Sa'd saw him he said:I seek refuge with Allah from the mischief of this rider. And as he got down he said to him: You are busy with your camels and your sheep and you have abandoned people who are contending with one another for kingdom. Sa'd struck his chest and said: Keep quite. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah loves the servant who is God-conscious and is free from want and is hidden (from the view of people)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَابْنُ، بِشْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، يَقُولُ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَوَّلُ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ رَمَى بِسَهْمٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلَقَدْ كُنَّا نَغْزُو مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا لَنَا طَعَامٌ نَأْكُلُهُ إِلاَّ وَرَقُ الْحُبْلَةِ وَهَذَا السَّمُرُ حَتَّى إِنَّ أَحَدَنَا لَيَضَعُ كَمَا تَضَعُ الشَّاةُ ثُمَّ أَصْبَحَتْ بَنُو أَسَدٍ تُعَزِّرُنِي عَلَى الدِّينِ لَقَدْ خِبْتُ إِذًا وَضَلَّ عَمَلِي وَلَمْ يَقُلِ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ إِذًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa almu'tamiru, qaala sami'tu iismaa'iyla, 'an qaysin, 'an sa'din, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy waabnu, bishrin qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an qaysin, qaala sami'tu sa'da bna aabiy waqqaasin, yaquwlu waalllahi iinniy laawwalu rajulin mina al'arabi ramaa bisahmin fiy sabiyli alllahi walaqad kunnaa naghzuw ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa lanaa ta'aamun naakuluhu iilaaa waraqu alhublaai wahadhaa alssamuru hattaa iinna aahadanaa layada'u kamaa tada'u alshhaaau thumma aasbahat banuw aasadin tu'azziruniy 'alaa alddiyni laqad khibtu iidhana wadalla 'amaliy walam yaquli abnu numayrin iidhana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas is reported to have, said:By Allah, I am the first person amongst the Arabs to throw an arrow in the cause of Allah and we used to go with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and there was no food for us to eat but only the leaves of hubla and samur trees (they are wild trees) and as a result thereof one amongst us would relieve himself as does the goat. (How strange it is) that now the people of Banu Asad (the progeny of Zubair) instruct me in religion and try to impose punishment upon me (in regard to it). If it is so (that I am so ignorant of religion), then indeed, I am undone and my deeds have been lost. Ibn Numair, however, did not make a mention of the word (idhan) thus? (in his narration)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ حَتَّى إِنْ كَانَ أَحَدُنَا لَيَضَعُ كَمَا تَضَعُ الْعَنْزُ مَا يَخْلِطُهُ بِشَىْءٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala hattaa iin kaana aahadunaa layada'u kamaa tada'u al'anzu maa yakhlituhu bishaa'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Isma'il b. Khalid with the same chain of transmitters and the words are:" One amongst us would relieve himself as the goats do without anything mixing with its excrement
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ الْعَدَوِيِّ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا عُتْبَةُ بْنُ غَزْوَانَ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنَّ الدُّنْيَا قَدْ آذَنَتْ بِصُرْمٍ وَوَلَّتْ حَذَّاءَ وَلَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْهَا إِلاَّ صُبَابَةٌ كَصُبَابَةِ الإِنَاءِ يَتَصَابُّهَا صَاحِبُهَا وَإِنَّكُمْ مُنْتَقِلُونَ مِنْهَا إِلَى دَارٍ لاَ زَوَالَ لَهَا فَانْتَقِلُوا بِخَيْرِ مَا بِحَضْرَتِكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ ذُكِرَ لَنَا أَنَّ الْحَجَرَ يُلْقَى مِنْ شَفَةِ جَهَنَّمَ فَيَهْوِي فِيهَا سَبْعِينَ عَامًا لاَ يُدْرِكُ لَهَا قَعْرًا وَوَاللَّهِ لَتُمْلأَنَّ أَفَعَجِبْتُمْ وَلَقَدْ ذُكِرَ لَنَا أَنَّ مَا بَيْنَ مِصْرَاعَيْنِ مِنْ مَصَارِيعِ الْجَنَّةِ مَسِيرَةُ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّ عَلَيْهَا يَوْمٌ وَهُوَ كَظِيظٌ مِنَ الزِّحَامِ وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي سَابِعَ سَبْعَةٍ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا لَنَا طَعَامٌ إِلاَّ وَرَقُ الشَّجَرِ حَتَّى قَرِحَتْ أَشْدَاقُنَا فَالْتَقَطْتُ بُرْدَةً فَشَقَقْتُهَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ فَاتَّزَرْتُ بِنِصْفِهَا وَاتَّزَرَ سَعْدٌ بِنِصْفِهَا فَمَا أَصْبَحَ الْيَوْمَ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ أَصْبَحَ أَمِيرًا عَلَى مِصْرٍ مِنَ الأَمْصَارِ وَإِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ أَنْ أَكُونَ فِي نَفْسِي عَظِيمًا وَعِنْدَ اللَّهِ صَغِيرًا وَإِنَّهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ نُبُوَّةٌ قَطُّ إِلاَّ تَنَاسَخَتْ حَتَّى يَكُونَ آخِرُ عَاقِبَتِهَا مُلْكًا فَسَتَخْبُرُونَ وَتُجَرِّبُونَ الأُمَرَاءَ بَعْدَنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, haddathanaa humaydu bnu hilaalin, 'an khaalidi bni 'umayrin al'adawiyyi, qaala khatabanaa 'utbaau bnu ghazwaana fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi thumma qaala aammaa ba'du faiinna alddunyaa qad adhanat bisurmin wawallat hadhhaa'a walam yabqa minhaa iilaaa subaabaaun kasubaabaai aliinaa'i yatasaabbuhaa saahibuhaa waiinnakum muntaqiluwna minhaa iilaa daarin laa zawaala lahaa faantaqiluwa bikhayri maa bihadratikum faiinnahu qad dhukira lanaa aanna alhajara yulqaa min shafaai jahannama fayahwiy fiyhaa sab'iyna 'aamana laa yudriku lahaa qa'rana wawaalllahi latumlaanna aafa'ajibtum walaqad dhukira lanaa aanna maa bayna misraa'ayni min masaariy'i aljannaai masiyraau aarba'iyna sanaaan walayaatiyanna 'alayhaa yawmun wahuwa kaziyzun mina alzzihaami walaqad raaaytuniy saabi'a sab'aain ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa lanaa ta'aamun iilaaa waraqu alshhajari hattaa qarihat aashdaaqunaa faaltaqattu burdaaan fashaqaqtuhaa bayniy wabayna sa'di bni maalikin faattazartu binisfihaa waattazara sa'dun binisfihaa famaa aasbaha alyawma minnaa aahadun iilaaa aasbaha aamiyrana 'alaa misrin mina alaamsaari waiinniy aa'uwdhu bialllahi aan aakuwna fiy nafsiy 'aziymana wa'inda alllahi saghiyrana waiinnahaa lam takun nubuwwaaun qattu iilaaa tanaasakhat hattaa yakuwna akhiru 'aaqibatihaa mulkana fasatakhburuwna watujarribuwna alaumaraa'a ba'danaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umair al-'Adawi reported:'Utba b. Ghazwan delivered us a sermon and he praised Allah and lauded Him, then said: Now coming to the point, verily the world has been given the news of its end and that too quite early. Nothing would be left out of it but only water left in the utensil which its owner leaves, and you are going to shift to an abode which knows no end, and you should shift with the good before you, for we have been told that a stone would be thrown at one side of the Hell and it would go down even for seventy years but would not be able to reach its bottom. By Allah, it would be fully packed. Do you find it something strange, and it has been mentioned that there yawns a distance which one would be able to cover in forty years from one end to another of Paradise, and a day would come when it would be fully packed and you must be knowing that I was the seventh amongst seven who had been with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we had nothing to eat but the leaves of the tree until the corners of the mouth were injured. We found a sheet which we tore in two and divided between myself and Sa'd b. Malik. I made the lower garment with halt of it and so did Sa'd make the lower garment with half of it and today there is none amongst us who has not become the governor of a city from amongst the cities (of the Islamic Commonwealth) and I seek refuge with Allah that I should consider myself great whereas I am insignificant in the eye of Allah. Prophethood does not remain for ever and its impact fades with the result that it changes eventually into kingship, and you would soon come to know and experience those rulers who would come after us and see (how far they are from religion)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَلِيطٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ، هِلاَلٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، وَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةَ قَالَ خَطَبَ عُتْبَةُ بْنُ غَزْوَانَ وَكَانَ أَمِيرًا عَلَى الْبَصْرَةِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ شَيْبَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu 'umara bni saliytin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, haddathanaa humaydu bnu, hilaalin 'an khaalidi bni 'umayrin, waqad aadraka aljaahiliyyaaa qaala khataba 'utbaau bnu ghazwaana wakaana aamiyrana 'alaa albasraai ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythi shaybaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Khalid b. 'Umair reported and he had seen the pre-Islamic days also, that 'Uqba b. Ghazwan delivered this address and he was the governor of Basra. The rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by Shaiban
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ قُرَّةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ، بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُتْبَةَ بْنَ غَزْوَانَ، يَقُولُ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي سَابِعَ سَبْعَةٍ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا طَعَامُنَا إِلاَّ وَرَقُ الْحُبْلَةِ حَتَّى قَرِحَتْ أَشْدَاقُنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an qurraaa bni khaalidin, 'an humaydi, bni hilaalin 'an khaalidi bni 'umayrin, qaala sami'tu 'utbaaa bna ghazwaana, yaquwlu laqad raaaytuniy saabi'a sab'aain ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa ta'aamunaa iilaaa waraqu alhublaai hattaa qarihat aashdaaqunaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Khalid b. Umair reported:I heard Uqba b. Ghazwan as saving: I found myself as the seventh amongst the seven who had been along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). We had nothing to eat but the leaves of hubla (a wild tree) until the corners of our mouths were injured
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلْ نَرَى رَبَّنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تُضَارُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ الشَّمْسِ فِي الظَّهِيرَةِ لَيْسَتْ فِي سَحَابَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلْ تُضَارُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ لَيْسَ فِي سَحَابَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لاَ تُضَارُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ رَبِّكُمْ إِلاَّ كَمَا تُضَارُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ أَحَدِهِمَا - قَالَ - فَيَلْقَى الْعَبْدَ فَيَقُولُ أَىْ فُلْ أَلَمْ أُكْرِمْكَ وَأُسَوِّدْكَ وَأُزَوِّجْكَ وَأُسَخِّرْ لَكَ الْخَيْلَ وَالإِبِلَ وَأَذَرْكَ تَرْأَسُ وَتَرْبَعُ فَيَقُولُ بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ فَيَقُولُ أَفَظَنَنْتَ أَنَّكَ مُلاَقِيَّ فَيَقُولُ لاَ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ فَإِنِّي أَنْسَاكَ كَمَا نَسِيتَنِي ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَلْقَى الثَّانِيَ فَيَقُولُ أَىْ فُلْ أَلَمْ أُكْرِمْكَ وَأُسَوِّدْكَ وَأُزَوِّجْكَ وَأُسَخِّرْ لَكَ الْخَيْلَ وَالإِبِلَ وَأَذَرْكَ تَرْأَسُ وَتَرْبَعُ فَيَقُولُ بَلَى أَىْ رَبِّ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ أَفَظَنَنْتَ أَنَّكَ مُلاَقِيَّ فَيَقُولُ لاَ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ فَإِنِّي أَنْسَاكَ كَمَا نَسِيتَنِي ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَلْقَى الثَّالِثَ فَيَقُولُ لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ فَيَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ آمَنْتُ بِكَ وَبِكِتَابِكَ وَبِرُسُلِكَ وَصَلَّيْتُ وَصُمْتُ وَتَصَدَّقْتُ ‏.‏ وَيُثْنِي بِخَيْرٍ مَا اسْتَطَاعَ فَيَقُولُ هَا هُنَا إِذًا - قَالَ - ثُمَّ يُقَالُ لَهُ الآنَ نَبْعَثُ شَاهِدَنَا عَلَيْكَ ‏.‏ وَيَتَفَكَّرُ فِي نَفْسِهِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْهَدُ عَلَىَّ فَيُخْتَمُ عَلَى فِيهِ وَيُقَالُ لِفَخِذِهِ وَلَحْمِهِ وَعِظَامِهِ انْطِقِي فَتَنْطِقُ فَخِذُهُ وَلَحْمُهُ وَعِظَامُهُ بِعَمَلِهِ وَذَلِكَ لِيُعْذِرَ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ ‏.‏ وَذَلِكَ الْمُنَافِقُ وَذَلِكَ الَّذِي يَسْخَطُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an suhayli bni aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi hal naraa rabbanaa yawma alqiyaamaai qaala ‏"‏ hal tudaarruwna fiy ruuyaai alshhamsi fiy alzzahiyraai laysat fiy sahaabaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fahal tudaarruwna fiy ruuyaai alqamari laylaaa albadri laysa fiy sahaabaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fawaalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laa tudaarruwna fiy ruuyaai rabbikum iilaaa kamaa tudaarruwna fiy ruuyaai aahadihimaa - qaala - fayalqaa al'abda fayaquwlu aaa ful aalam aukrimka waausawwidka waauzawwijka waausakhhir laka alkhayla waaliibila waaadharka taraasu watarba'u fayaquwlu balaa ‏.‏ qaala fayaquwlu aafazananta aannaka mulaaqiyya fayaquwlu laa ‏.‏ fayaquwlu faiinniy aansaaka kamaa nasiytaniy ‏.‏ thumma yalqaa althhaaniya fayaquwlu aaa ful aalam aukrimka waausawwidka waauzawwijka waausakhhir laka alkhayla waaliibila waaadharka taraasu watarba'u fayaquwlu balaa aaa rabbi ‏.‏ fayaquwlu aafazananta aannaka mulaaqiyya fayaquwlu laa ‏.‏ fayaquwlu faiinniy aansaaka kamaa nasiytaniy ‏.‏ thumma yalqaa althhaalitha fayaquwlu lahu mithla dhalika fayaquwlu yaa rabbi amantu bika wabikitaabika wabirusulika wasallaytu wasumtu watasaddaqtu ‏.‏ wayuthniy bikhayrin maa astataa'a fayaquwlu haa hunaa iidhana - qaala - thumma yuqaalu lahu alana nab'athu shaahidanaa 'alayka ‏.‏ wayatafakkaru fiy nafsihi man dhaa alladhiy yashhadu 'alaaaa fayukhtamu 'alaa fiyhi wayuqaalu lifakhidhihi walahmihi wa'izaamihi antiqiy fatantiqu fakhidhuhu walahmuhu wa'izaamuhu bi'amalihi wadhalika liyu'dhira min nafsihi ‏.‏ wadhalika almunaafiqu wadhalika alladhiy yaskhatu alllahu 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that they (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said:Allah's Messenger, will we be able to see our Lord on the Day of Judgment? He said: Do you feel any difficulty in seeing the sun in the noon when there is no cloud over it? They said: No. He again said: Do you feel any difficulty in seeing the moon on the fourteenth night when there is no cloud over it? They said: No. Thereupon he said: By Allah Who is One in Whose Hand is my life. you will not face any difficulty in seeing your Lord but only so much as you feel in seeing one of them. Then Allah would sit in judgment upon the servant and would say: O, so and so, did I not honour you and make you the chief and provide you the spouse and subdue for you horses, camels, and afforded you an opportunity to rule over your subjects? He would say: Yes. And then it would be said: Did you not think that you would meet Us? And he would say: No. Thereupon He (Allah) would say: Well, We forget you as you forgot Us. Then the second person would be brought for judgment. (And Allah would) say: 0, so and so. did We not honour you and make you the chief and make you pair and subdue for you horses and camels and afford you an opportunity to rule over your subjects? He would say: Yes, my Lord. And He (the Lord) would say: Did you not think that you would be meeting Us? And he would say: No. And then He (Allah) would say: Well, I forget you today as you forgot Us. Then the third -one would be brought and He (Allah) would say to him as He said before. And he (the third person) would say: O, my Lord, I affirmed my faith in Thee and in Thy Book and in Thy Messenger and I observed prayer and fasts and gave charity, and he would speak in good terms like this as he would be able to do. And He (Allah) would say: Well, We will bring our witnesses to you. And the man would think in his mind who would bear witness upon him and then his mouth would be sealed and it would be said to his thighs, to his flesh and to his bones to speak and his thighs. flesh and bones would bear witness to his deeds and it would be done so that he should not be able to make any excuse for himself and he would be a hypocrite and Allah would be annoyed with him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو النَّضْرِ، هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ الأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدٍ الْمُكْتِبِ، عَنْ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَضَحِكَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تَدْرُونَ مِمَّ أَضْحَكُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مِنْ مُخَاطَبَةِ الْعَبْدِ رَبَّهُ يَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ أَلَمْ تُجِرْنِي مِنَ الظُّلْمِ قَالَ يَقُولُ بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ فَيَقُولُ فَإِنِّي لاَ أُجِيزُ عَلَى نَفْسِي إِلاَّ شَاهِدًا مِنِّي قَالَ فَيَقُولُ كَفَى بِنَفْسِكَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ شَهِيدًا وَبِالْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ شُهُودًا - قَالَ - فَيُخْتَمُ عَلَى فِيهِ فَيُقَالُ لأَرْكَانِهِ انْطِقِي ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَنْطِقُ بِأَعْمَالِهِ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ يُخَلَّى بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْكَلاَمِ - قَالَ - فَيَقُولُ بُعْدًا لَكُنَّ وَسُحْقًا ‏.‏ فَعَنْكُنَّ كُنْتُ أُنَاضِلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu alnnadri bni aabiy alnnadri, haddathaniy aabuw alnnadri, haashimu bnu alqaasimi haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi alaashja'iyyu, 'an sufyaana althhawriyyi, 'an 'ubaydin almuktibi, 'an fudaylin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kunnaa 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadahika faqaala ‏"‏ hal tadruwna mimma aadhaku ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qulnaa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ min mukhaatabaai al'abdi rabbahu yaquwlu yaa rabbi aalam tujirniy mina alzzulmi qaala yaquwlu balaa ‏.‏ qaala fayaquwlu faiinniy laa aujiyzu 'alaa nafsiy iilaaa shaahidana minniy qaala fayaquwlu kafaa binafsika alyawma 'alayka shahiydana wabialkiraami alkaatibiyna shuhuwdana - qaala - fayukhtamu 'alaa fiyhi fayuqaalu laarkaanihi antiqiy ‏.‏ qaala fatantiqu biaa'maalihi - qaala - thumma yukhallaa baynahu wabayna alkalaami - qaala - fayaquwlu bu'dana lakunna wasuhqana ‏.‏ fa'ankunna kuntu aunaadilu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he smiled, and said: Do you know why I laughed? We said: Allah and His Messenger, know best. Thereupon he said: It was because (there came to my mind the) talk which the servant would have with his Lord (on the Day of judgment). He would say: My Lord, have you not guaranteed me protection against injustice? He would say: Yes. Then the servant would say: I do not deem valid any witness against me but my own self, and He would say: Well, enough would be the witness of your self against you and that of the two angels who had been appointed to record your deeds. Then the seal would be set upon his mouth and it would be said to his hands and feet to speak and they would speak of his deeds. Then the mouth would be made free to talk, he would say (to the hands and feet): Be away, let there be curse of Allah upon you. It was for your safety that I contended
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ رِزْقَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ قُوتًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'umaaraaa bni alqa'qaa'i, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alllahumma aj'al rizqa ali muhammadin quwtana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:O Allah, make for the family of Muhammad the provision which is a bare subsistence
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ رِزْقَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ قُوتًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ عَمْرٍو ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waaabuw kuraybin qaaluwa haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an 'umaaraaa bni alqa'qaa'i, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alllahumma aj'al rizqa ali muhammadin quwtana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai 'amrinw ‏"‏ alllahumma arzuq ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:0 Allah, provide for the, family of Muhammad their subsistence, and in the narration transmitted on the authority of 'Amr (the words are):" O Allah, provide us subsistence
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الأَعْمَشَ، ذَكَرَ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ كَفَافًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw sa'iydin alaashajju, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, qaala sami'tu alaa'masha, dhakara 'an 'umaaraaa, bni alqa'qaa'i bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏ "‏ kafaafana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umara b. al-Qa'qa' reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters but instead of the word" qut" (bare subsistence) there has been used the word" Kafaf" (adequate means to meet the needs)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا شَبِعَ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُنْذُ قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ مِنْ طَعَامِ بُرٍّ ثَلاَثَ لَيَالٍ تِبَاعًا حَتَّى قُبِضَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala, zuhayrun haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat maa shabi'a alu muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm mundhu qadima almadiynaaa min ta'aami burrin thalaatha layaalin tibaa'ana hattaa qubida ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Never had the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) eaten to the fill since their, arrival in Medina with the bread of wheat for three successive nights until his (Holy Prophet's) death
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا شَبِعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ تِبَاعًا مِنْ خُبْزِ بُرٍّ حَتَّى مَضَى لِسَبِيلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat maa shabi'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thalaathaaa aayyaamin tibaa'ana min khubzi burrin hattaa madaa lisabiylihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Never did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eat to his fill the bread of wheat for three successive days until he had run the course of his life
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ مَا شَبِعَ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ خُبْزِ شَعِيرٍ يَوْمَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ حَتَّى قُبِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu 'abda alrrahmani bna yaziyda, yuhaddithu 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat maa shabi'a alu muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm min khubzi sha'iyrin yawmayni mutataabi'ayni hattaa qubida rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Never did the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) eat to the fill the bread of barley for two successive days until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَابِسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا شَبِعَ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ خُبْزِ بُرٍّ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'aabisin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat maa shabi'a alu muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm min khubzi burrin fawqa thalaathin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Never could the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) (afford to eat to the fill) the bread of wheat beyond three days (successively)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، بْنَ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَصْحَابِ الْحِجْرِ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُوا عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ الْقَوْمِ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونُوا بَاكِينَ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُونُوا بَاكِينَ فَلاَ تَدْخُلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْ يُصِيبَكُمْ مِثْلُ مَا أَصَابَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, jamiy'ana 'an iismaa'iyla, qaala abnu aayyuwba haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu diynaarin, aannahu sami'a 'abda alllahi, bna 'umara yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laashaabi alhijri ‏ "‏ laa tadkhuluwa 'alaa hauulaa'i alqawmi almu'adhhabiyna iilaaa aan takuwnuwa baakiyna faiin lam takuwnuwa baakiyna falaa tadkhuluwa 'alayhim aan yusiybakum mithlu maa aasaabahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said in connection with the people of Hijr (Thamud):Do not enter but weepingly (the habitations) of these people who had been punished by (Allah), and in case you do not feel inclined to weep, then do not enter (these habitations) that you may not meet the same calamity as had fallen to their lot
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، - وَهُوَ يَذْكُرُ الْحِجْرَ مَسَاكِنَ ثَمُودَ - قَالَ سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ قَالَ مَرَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْحِجْرِ فَقَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُوا مَسَاكِنَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونُوا بَاكِينَ حَذَرًا أَنْ يُصِيبَكُمْ مِثْلُ مَا أَصَابَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ زَجَرَ فَأَسْرَعَ حَتَّى خَلَّفَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, - wahuwa yadhkuru alhijra masaakina thamuwda - qaala saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi iinna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara qaala mararnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alhijri faqaala lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tadkhuluwa masaakina alladhiyna zalamuwa aanfusahum iilaaa aan takuwnuwa baakiyna hadharana aan yusiybakum mithlu maa aasaabahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma zajara faaasra'a hattaa khallafahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Shihab reported, and he had been talking about the stony abodes of Thamud, and he said:Salim b. 'Abdullah reported that 'Abdullah b. Umar said: We were passing along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) through the habitations of Hijr, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do not enter but weepingly the habitations of these persons who committed tyranny among themselves, lest the same calamity should fall upon you as it fell upon them. He then urged his mount to proceed quickly and pass through that valley hurriedly
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ النَّاسَ نَزَلُوا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْحِجْرِ أَرْضِ ثَمُودَ فَاسْتَقَوْا مِنْ آبَارِهَا وَعَجَنُوا بِهِ الْعَجِينَ فَأَمَرَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُهَرِيقُوا مَا اسْتَقَوْا وَيَعْلِفُوا الإِبِلَ الْعَجِينَ وَأَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَسْتَقُوا مِنَ الْبِئْرِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ تَرِدُهَا النَّاقَةُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alhakamu bnu muwsaa aabuw saalihin, haddathanaa shu'aybu bnu iishaaqa, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, aakhbarahu aanna alnnaasa nazaluwa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alhijri aardi thamuwda faastaqawa min abaarihaa wa'ajanuwa bihi al'ajiyna faaamarahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuhariyquwa maa astaqawa waya'lifuwa aliibila al'ajiyna waaamarahum aan yastaquwa mina albiiri allatiy kaanat tariduhaa alnnaaqaau ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that the people encamped along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the valley of Hijr, the habitations of Thamud, and they quenched their thirst from the wells thereof and kneaded the flour with it. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that the water collected for drinking should be spilt and the flour should be given to the camels and commanded them that the water for drinking should be taken from that well where the she-camel (of Hadrat Salih) used to come
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مُوسَى الأَنْصَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَاسْتَقَوْا مِنْ بِئَارِهَا وَاعْتَجَنُوا بِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu muwsaa alaansaariyyu, haddathanaa aanasu bnu 'iyaadin, haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ghayra aannahu qaala faastaqawa min biiaarihaa waa'tajanuwa bihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ السَّاعِي عَلَى الأَرْمَلَةِ وَالْمِسْكِينِ كَالْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ - وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ - وَكَالْقَائِمِ لاَ يَفْتُرُ وَكَالصَّائِمِ لاَ يُفْطِرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa maalikun, 'an thawri bni zaydin, 'an aabiy alghaythi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alssaa'iy 'alaa alaarmalaai waalmiskiyni kaalmujaahidi fiy sabiyli alllahi - waaahsibuhu qaala - wakaalqaaiimi laa yafturu wakaalssaaiimi laa yuftiru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:One who makes efforts (for earning to be spent) on a widow and the destitute is like a striver in the cause of Allah, and I think he also said: He is like one who constantly stands for prayer and observes fast without breaking it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، الدِّيلِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْغَيْثِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كَافِلُ الْيَتِيمِ لَهُ أَوْ لِغَيْرِهِ أَنَا وَهُوَ كَهَاتَيْنِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَشَارَ مَالِكٌ بِالسَّبَّابَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu 'iysaa, haddathanaa maalikun, 'an thawri bni zaydin, alddiyliyyi qaala sami'tu aabaa alghaythi, yuhaddithu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kaafilu alyatiymi lahu aaw lighayrihi aanaa wahuwa kahaatayni fiy aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaashaara maalikun bialssabbaabaai waalwustaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:One who looks after the orphan whether he is his relative or not, I and he would be together in Paradise like this, and Malik (explained it) with the gesture by drawing his index finger and middle finger close together
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ - أَنَّ بُكَيْرًا، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَاصِمَ بْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ الْخَوْلاَنِيَّ، يَذْكُرُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ، عِنْدَ قَوْلِ النَّاسِ فِيهِ حِينَ بَنَى مَسْجِدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّكُمْ قَدْ أَكْثَرْتُمْ وَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَنْ بَنَى مَسْجِدًا - قَالَ بُكَيْرٌ حَسِبْتُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ - يَبْتَغِي بِهِ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ بَنَى اللَّهُ لَهُ مِثْلَهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ هَارُونَ ‏"‏ بَنَى اللَّهُ لَهُ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, - wahuwa abnu alhaarithi - aanna bukayrana, haddathahu aanna 'aasima bna 'umara bni qataadaaa haddathahu aannahu, sami'a 'ubayda alllahi alkhawlaaniyya, yadhkuru aannahu sami'a 'uthmaana bna 'affaana, 'inda qawli alnnaasi fiyhi hiyna banaa masjida rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinnakum qad aakthartum waiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ man banaa masjidana - qaala bukayrun hasibtu aannahu qaala - yabtaghiy bihi wajha alllahi banaa alllahu lahu mithlahu fiy aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai haaruwna ‏"‏ banaa alllahu lahu baytana fiy aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah al-Khaulani reported that when Uthman b. 'Affan tried to rebuild the mosque of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the people began to talk about this. Uthman b. 'Affan said:You discuss it very much whereas I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who builds a mosque-- and the narrator Bukair said: I think he also said: (for) seeking the pleasure of Allah- Allah would build (a similar house for him in Paradise). and in the narration of Harun (the words are):" A house for him in Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ، - قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، - أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ، أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ، أَرَادَ بِنَاءَ الْمَسْجِدِ فَكَرِهَ النَّاسُ ذَلِكَ وَأَحَبُّوا أَنْ يَدَعَهُ عَلَى هَيْئَتِهِ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ بَنَى مَسْجِدًا لِلَّهِ بَنَى اللَّهُ لَهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ مِثْلَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, kilaahumaa 'ani alddahhaaki, - qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa alddahhaaku bnu makhladin, - aakhbaranaa 'abdu alhamiydi bnu ja'farin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an mahmuwdi bni labiydin, aanna 'uthmaana bna 'affaana, aaraada binaa'a almasjidi fakariha alnnaasu dhalika waaahabbuwa aan yada'ahu 'alaa hayiatihi faqaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man banaa masjidana lillahi banaa alllahu lahu fiy aljannaai mithlahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mahmud b. Labid reported that 'Uthman b. 'Affan decided to rebuild the mosque (of Allah's Apostle in Medina) but the people did not like this idea and they wished that it should be preserved in the same (old) form. Thereupon he (Hadrat 'Uthman) said:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who builds a mosque for Allah, Allah would build for him (a house) in Paradise like it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ، الصَّبَّاحِ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏ "‏ بَنَى اللَّهُ لَهُ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, haddathanaa aabuw bakrin alhanafiyyu, wa'abdu almaliki bnu, alssabbaahi kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi alhamiydi bni ja'farin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aanna fiy, hadiythihimaa ‏ "‏ banaa alllahu lahu baytana fiy aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ja'far with the same chain of transmitters with this variation (that the words are):" Allah would build for him a house in Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، اللَّيْثِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بَيْنَا رَجُلٌ بِفَلاَةٍ مِنَ الأَرْضِ فَسَمِعَ صَوْتًا فِي سَحَابَةٍ اسْقِ حَدِيقَةَ فُلاَنٍ ‏.‏ فَتَنَحَّى ذَلِكَ السَّحَابُ فَأَفْرَغَ مَاءَهُ فِي حَرَّةٍ فَإِذَا شَرْجَةٌ مِنْ تِلْكَ الشِّرَاجِ قَدِ اسْتَوْعَبَتْ ذَلِكَ الْمَاءَ كُلَّهُ فَتَتَبَّعَ الْمَاءَ فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ قَائِمٌ فِي حَدِيقَتِهِ يُحَوِّلُ الْمَاءَ بِمِسْحَاتِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ مَا اسْمُكَ قَالَ فُلاَنٌ ‏.‏ لِلاِسْمِ الَّذِي سَمِعَ فِي السَّحَابَةِ فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ لِمَ تَسْأَلُنِي عَنِ اسْمِي فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ صَوْتًا فِي السَّحَابِ الَّذِي هَذَا مَاؤُهُ يَقُولُ اسْقِ حَدِيقَةَ فُلاَنٍ لاِسْمِكَ فَمَا تَصْنَعُ فِيهَا قَالَ أَمَّا إِذَا قُلْتَ هَذَا فَإِنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا فَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِثُلُثِهِ وَآكُلُ أَنَا وَعِيَالِي ثُلُثًا وَأَرُدُّ فِيهَا ثُلُثَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - qaalaa haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy salamaaa, 'an wahbi bni kaysaana, 'an 'ubaydi bni 'umayrin, alllaythiyyi 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ baynaa rajulun bifalaaain mina alaardi fasami'a sawtana fiy sahaabaain asqi hadiyqaaa fulaanin ‏.‏ fatanahhaa dhalika alssahaabu faaafragha maa'ahu fiy harraain faiidhaa sharjaaun min tilka alshhiraaji qadi astaw'abat dhalika almaa'a kullahu fatatabba'a almaa'a faiidhaa rajulun qaaiimun fiy hadiyqatihi yuhawwilu almaa'a bimishaatihi faqaala lahu yaa 'abda alllahi maa asmuka qaala fulaanun ‏.‏ lilaismi alladhiy sami'a fiy alssahaabaai faqaala lahu yaa 'abda alllahi lima tasaaluniy 'ani asmiy faqaala iinniy sami'tu sawtana fiy alssahaabi alladhiy hadhaa maauuhu yaquwlu asqi hadiyqaaa fulaanin laismika famaa tasna'u fiyhaa qaala aammaa iidhaa qulta hadhaa faiinniy aanzuru iilaa maa yakhruju minhaa faaatasaddaqu bithuluthihi waakulu aanaa wa'iyaaliy thuluthana waaaruddu fiyhaa thuluthahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:While a person was in the wilderness he heard a voice from the cloud (commanding it thus): Irrigate the garden of so and so. (After that the clouds slinked aside and poured water on a stony ground. It filled a channel amongst the channels of that land and that person followed that water and he found a person standing in the garden busy in changing the course of water with the help of a hatchet. He said to him: Servant of Allah, what is your name? he said: So and so. And it was that very name which he had heard from the clouds. and he said to him: Servant of Allah, why do you ask me my name? He said: I heard a voice from the clouds of which is the downpour, saying: Water the garden of so and so, like your name. What do you do (for the favour) shown to you by Allah in this matter? He said: Now as you state so. I look what yield I get from it, and I give one-third as charity out of it and I and my children eat one-third of it and one-third I return to it as investment
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ الضَّبِّيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَأَجْعَلُ ثُلُثَهُ فِي الْمَسَاكِينِ وَالسَّائِلِينَ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aahmadu bnu 'abdaaa alddabbiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw daawuda, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy salamaaa, haddathanaa wahbu bnu kaysaana, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ waaaj'alu thuluthahu fiy almasaakiyni waalssaaiiliyna waabni alssabiyli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Wahb b. Kaisan with the same chain of transmitters but with this change that he said:" I earmark one-third for the poor, the needy and the wayfarers
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى أَنَا أَغْنَى الشُّرَكَاءِ عَنِ الشِّرْكِ مَنْ عَمِلَ عَمَلاً أَشْرَكَ فِيهِ مَعِي غَيْرِي تَرَكْتُهُ وَشِرْكَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa rawhu bnu alqaasimi, 'ani al'alaa'i bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni ya'quwba, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ qaala alllahu tabaaraka wata'aalaa aanaa aaghnaa alshhurakaa'i 'ani alshhirki man 'amila 'amalaan aashraka fiyhi ma'iy ghayriy taraktuhu washirkahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as stating that Allah the Most High and Exalted said:I am the One, One Who does not stand in need of a partner. If anyone does anything in which he associates anyone else with Me, I shall abandon him with one whom he associates with Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ سُمَيْعٍ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، الْبَطِينِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ سَمَّعَ سَمَّعَ اللَّهُ بِهِ وَمَنْ رَاءَى رَاءَى اللَّهُ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyaathin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an iismaa'iyla bni sumay'in, 'an muslimin, albatiyni 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man samma'a samma'a alllahu bihi waman raa'aa raa'aa alllahu bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:If anyone wants to have his deeds widely publicised, Allah will publicise (his humiliation). And if anyone makes a hypocritical display (of his deeds) Allah will make a display of him
