verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ، يَقُولُ جَاءَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ إِلَى أَبِي فِي مَنْزِلِهِ فَاشْتَرَى مِنْهُ رَحْلاً فَقَالَ لِعَازِبٍ ابْعَثْ مَعِيَ ابْنَكَ يَحْمِلْهُ مَعِي إِلَى مَنْزِلِي فَقَالَ لِي أَبِي احْمِلْهُ ‏.‏ فَحَمَلْتُهُ وَخَرَجَ أَبِي مَعَهُ يَنْتَقِدُ ثَمَنَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبِي يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ حَدِّثْنِي كَيْفَ صَنَعْتُمَا لَيْلَةَ سَرَيْتَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ أَسْرَيْنَا لَيْلَتَنَا كُلَّهَا حَتَّى قَامَ قَائِمُ الظَّهِيرَةِ وَخَلاَ الطَّرِيقُ فَلاَ يَمُرُّ فِيهِ أَحَدٌ حَتَّى رُفِعَتْ لَنَا صَخْرَةٌ طَوِيلَةٌ لَهَا ظِلٌّ لَمْ تَأْتِ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ بَعْدُ فَنَزَلْنَا عِنْدَهَا فَأَتَيْتُ الصَّخْرَةَ فَسَوَّيْتُ بِيَدِي مَكَانًا يَنَامُ فِيهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ظِلِّهَا ثُمَّ بَسَطْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَرْوَةً ثُمَّ قُلْتُ نَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَأَنَا أَنْفُضُ لَكَ مَا حَوْلَكَ فَنَامَ وَخَرَجْتُ أَنْفُضُ مَا حَوْلَهُ فَإِذَا أَنَا بِرَاعِي غَنَمٍ مُقْبِلٍ بِغَنَمِهِ إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ يُرِيدُ مِنْهَا الَّذِي أَرَدْنَا فَلَقِيتُهُ فَقُلْتُ لِمَنْ أَنْتَ يَا غُلاَمُ فَقَالَ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ قُلْتُ أَفِي غَنَمِكَ لَبَنٌ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَفَتَحْلُبُ لِي قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَ شَاةً فَقُلْتُ لَهُ انْفُضِ الضَّرْعَ مِنَ الشَّعَرِ وَالتُّرَابِ وَالْقَذَى - قَالَ فَرَأَيْتُ الْبَرَاءَ يَضْرِبُ بِيَدِهِ عَلَى الأُخْرَى يَنْفُضُ - فَحَلَبَ لِي فِي قَعْبٍ مَعَهُ كُثْبَةً مِنْ لَبَنٍ قَالَ وَمَعِي إِدَاوَةٌ أَرْتَوِي فِيهَا لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيَشْرَبَ مِنْهَا وَيَتَوَضَّأَ - قَالَ - فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أُوقِظَهُ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ فَوَافَقْتُهُ اسْتَيْقَظَ فَصَبَبْتُ عَلَى اللَّبَنِ مِنَ الْمَاءِ حَتَّى بَرَدَ أَسْفَلُهُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اشْرَبْ مِنْ هَذَا اللَّبَنِ - قَالَ - فَشَرِبَ حَتَّى رَضِيتُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلرَّحِيلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ فَارْتَحَلْنَا بَعْدَ مَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَاتَّبَعَنَا سُرَاقَةُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ - قَالَ - وَنَحْنُ فِي جَلَدٍ مِنَ الأَرْضِ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُتِينَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَدَعَا عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَارْتَطَمَتْ فَرَسُهُ إِلَى بَطْنِهَا أُرَى فَقَالَ إِنِّي قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّكُمَا قَدْ دَعَوْتُمَا عَلَىَّ فَادْعُوَا لِي فَاللَّهُ لَكُمَا أَنْ أَرُدَّ عَنْكُمَا الطَّلَبَ ‏.‏ فَدَعَا اللَّهَ فَنَجَى فَرَجَعَ لاَ يَلْقَى أَحَدًا إِلاَّ قَالَ قَدْ كَفَيْتُكُمْ مَا هَا هُنَا فَلاَ يَلْقَى أَحَدًا إِلاَّ رَدَّهُ - قَالَ - وَوَفَى لَنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, hadaathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, hadaathanaa zuhayrun, hadaathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a bna 'aazibin, yaquwlu jaa'a aabuw bakrin alsiidiiyqu iilaa aabiy fiy manzilihi faashtaraa minhu rahlaan faqaala li'aazibin ab'ath ma'iya abnaka yahmilhu ma'iy iilaa manziliy faqaala liy aabiy ahmilhu ‏.‏ fahamaltuhu wakharaja aabiy ma'ahu yantaqidu thamanahu faqaala lahu aabiy yaa aabaa bakrin hadiithniy kayfa sana'tumaa laylaaa sarayta ma'a rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala na'am aasraynaa laylatanaa kulaahaa hataaa qaama qaaiimu alzaahiyraai wakhalaa altaariyqu falaa yamuruu fiyhi aahadun hataaa rufi'at lanaa sakhraaun tawiylaaun lahaa zilunn lam taati 'alayhi alshaamsu ba'du fanazalnaa 'indahaa faaataytu alsaakhraaa fasawaaytu biyadiy makaanana yanaamu fiyhi alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ziliihaa thumaa basattu 'alayhi farwaaan thumaa qultu nam yaa rasuwla allaahi waaanaa aanfudu laka maa hawlaka fanaama wakharajtu aanfudu maa hawlahu faiidhaa aanaa biraa'iy ghanamin muqbilin bighanamihi iilaa alsaakhraai yuriydu minhaa alaadhiy aaradnaa falaqiytuhu faqultu liman aanta yaa ghulaamu faqaala lirajulin min aahli almadiynaai qultu aafiy ghanamika labanun qaala na'am ‏.‏ qultu aafatahlubu liy qaala na'am ‏.‏ faaakhadha shaaaan faqultu lahu anfudi aldaar'a mina alshaa'ari waaltuuraabi waalqadhaa - qaala faraaaytu albaraa'a yadribu biyadihi 'alaa alaukhraa yanfudu - fahalaba liy fiy qa'bin ma'ahu kuthbaaan min labanin qaala wama'iy iidaawaaun aartawiy fiyhaa lilnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm liyashraba minhaa wayatawadaaaa - qaala - faaataytu alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm wakarihtu aan auwqizahu min nawmihi fawaafaqtuhu astayqaza fasababtu 'alaa allaabani mina almaa'i hataaa barada aasfaluhu faqultu yaa rasuwla allaahi ashrab min hadhaa allaabani - qaala - fashariba hataaa radiytu thumaa qaala ‏"‏ aalam yaani lilraahiyli ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu balaa ‏.‏ qaala faartahalnaa ba'da maa zaalati alshaamsu waataaba'anaa suraaqaau bnu maalikin - qaala - wanahnu fiy jaladin mina alaardi faqultu yaa rasuwla allaahi autiynaa faqaala ‏"‏ laa tahzan iinaa allaaha ma'anaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fada'aa 'alayhi rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faartatamat farasuhu iilaa batnihaa auraa faqaala iiniiy qad 'alimtu aanaakumaa qad da'awtumaa 'alaaaa faad'uwaa liy faallaahu lakumaa aan aarudaa 'ankumaa altaalaba ‏.‏ fada'aa allaaha fanajaa faraja'a laa yalqaa aahadana iilaaa qaala qad kafaytukum maa haa hunaa falaa yalqaa aahadana iilaaa radaahu - qaala - wawafaa lanaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that Abu Bakr Siddiq came to the residence of my father ('Azib) and bought a haudaj from him and said to 'Azib:Send your son to my residence (to carry this haudaj), and my father said to me: Carry it (for him). So I carried it and there went along with him (with Abu Bakr) my father in order to fetch its price and he ('Azib) said to Abu Bakr: Abu Bakr, narrate to me what you both did on the night when you set out on a journey along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He said: We set out during the night and went on walking until it was noon, and the path was vacant and so none passed by that (until) there appeared prominently before us a large rock. It had its shade and the rays of the sun did not reach that place. So we got down at that place. I then went to the rock and levelled the ground with my hands at the place where the Prophet (ﷺ) would take rest under its shade. I then set the bedding and said: Allah's Messenger, go to sleep and I shall keep a watch around you. I went out and watched around him. There we saw a shepherd moving towards that rock with his flock and he intended what we intended (i. e. taking rest). I met him and said to him: Young boy, to which place do you belong? He said: I am a person from Medina. I said, is there any milk in the udders of your sheep and goats? He said: Yes. He took hold of a goat, and I said to him: Clean the udder well so that it should be free from hair, dust and impurity. I saw al-Bara' striking his hand upon the other (to give an indication) how he did that. He milked the goat for me in a wooden cup which he had with him and I had with me a bucket in which I kept water for drinking and for performing ablution. I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and did not like to awaken him from sleep but he was accidentally startled from the sleep. I poured water upon the milk (till It was cold) and I said: Allah's Messenger, take this milk. He then took It and I was delighted and he (the Holy Prophet) said: Is now not the time to march on? I said: Of course. So he marched on after the sun had passed the meridian and Suraqa b. Malik pursued us and we had been walking on soft, level ground. I said: Allah's Messenger, we are about to be overtaken by them. Thereupon he said: Be not grieved. Verily, Allah is with us. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cursed him and his horse sank into the earth. I think he also said: I know you have hurled curse upon me. So supplicate Allah for me and I take an oath that I shall turn everyone away who would come in search of you. So he (Allah's Messenger) supplicated Allah and he was rescued and he came back and to everyone he met, he said: I have combed all this side. In short, he diverted everyone whom he met and he in fact fulfilled his promise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ اشْتَرَى أَبُو بَكْرٍ مِنْ أَبِي رَحْلاً بِثَلاَثَةَ عَشَرَ دِرْهَمًا وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ زُهَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ وَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ مِنْ رِوَايَةِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عُمَرَ فَلَمَّا دَنَا دَعَا عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَاخَ فَرَسُهُ فِي الأَرْضِ إِلَى بَطْنِهِ وَوَثَبَ عَنْهُ وَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ هَذَا عَمَلُكَ فَادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُخَلِّصَنِي مِمَّا أَنَا فِيهِ وَلَكَ عَلَىَّ لأُعَمِّيَنَّ عَلَى مَنْ وَرَائِي وَهَذِهِ كِنَانَتِي فَخُذْ سَهْمًا مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ سَتَمُرُّ عَلَى إِبِلِي وَغِلْمَانِي بِمَكَانِ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَخُذْ مِنْهَا حَاجَتَكَ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ حَاجَةَ لِي فِي إِبِلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ لَيْلاً فَتَنَازَعُوا أَيُّهُمْ يَنْزِلُ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْزِلُ عَلَى بَنِي النَّجَّارِ أَخْوَالِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ أُكْرِمُهُمْ بِذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَصَعِدَ الرِّجَالُ وَالنِّسَاءُ فَوْقَ الْبُيُوتِ وَتَفَرَّقَ الْغِلْمَانُ وَالْخَدَمُ فِي الطُّرُقِ يُنَادُونَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ يَا مُحَمَّدُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahadaathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, hadaathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, h wahadaathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa alnaadru bnu shumaylin, kilaahumaa 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i, qaala ashtaraa aabuw bakrin min aabiy rahlaan bithalaathaaa 'ashara dirhamana wasaaqa alhadiytha bima'naa hadiythi zuhayrin 'an aabiy iishaaqa waqaala fiy hadiythihi min riwaayaai 'uthmaana bni 'umara falamaaa danaa da'aa 'alayhi rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaakha farasuhu fiy alaardi iilaa batnihi wawathaba 'anhu waqaala yaa muhamaadu qad 'alimtu aanaa hadhaa 'amaluka faad'u allaaha aan yukhaliisaniy mimaaa aanaa fiyhi walaka 'alaaaa lau'amiiyanaa 'alaa man waraaiiy wahadhihi kinaanatiy fakhudh sahmana minhaa faiinaaka satamuruu 'alaa iibiliy waghilmaaniy bimakaani kadhaa wakadhaa fakhudh minhaa haajataka qaala ‏"‏ laa haajaaa liy fiy iibilika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqadimnaa almadiynaaa laylaan fatanaaza'uwa aayuuhum yanzilu 'alayhi rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aanzilu 'alaa baniy alnaajaaari aakhwaali 'abdi almutaalibi aukrimuhum bidhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fasa'ida alriijaalu waalniisaa'u fawqa albuyuwti watafaraaqa alghilmaanu waalkhadamu fiy altuuruqi yunaaduwna yaa muhamaadu yaa rasuwla allaahi yaa muhamaadu yaa rasuwla allaahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' reported:Abu Bakr purchased a saddle from me for thirteen dirhams; the rest of the hadith is the same, and in the narration of Uthman b. 'Umar, the words are: He (Suraqa b. Malik) drew near Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he (the Holy Prophet) cursed him and his camel sank in the earth up to the belly and he jumped from that and said: Muhammad, I am fully aware of It that it is your doing. Supplicate Allah that He should rescue me from it in which I am (pitchforked) and I give you a solemn pledge that I shall keep this as a secret from all those who are coming after me. Take hold of an arrow out of it (quiver) for you will find my camels and my slaves at such and such place and you can get whatever you need (on showing this arrow). He (the Holy Prophet) said: I don't need your camels. And we (the Prophet and Abu Bakr) came to Medina during the night and the people began to contend as to where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) should reside and he encamped in the tribe of Najjar who were related to 'Abd ul-Muttalib from the side of mother. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) honoured them, then people climbed upon house-top and women also and boys scattered in the way, and they were all crying: Muhammad, Messenger of Allah, Muhammad, Messenger of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ قِيلَ لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ ‏{‏ ادْخُلُوا الْبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَقُولُوا حِطَّةٌ يُغْفَرْ لَكُمْ خَطَايَاكُمْ‏}‏ فَبَدَّلُوا فَدَخَلُوا الْبَابَ يَزْحَفُونَ عَلَى أَسْتَاهِهِمْ وَقَالُوا حَبَّةٌ فِي شَعَرَةٍ"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa muhamaadu bnu raafi'in, hadaathanaa 'abdu alraazaaaqi, hadaathanaa ma'marun, 'an hamaaami bni munabiihin, qaala hadhaa maa hadaathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ qiyla libaniy iisraaiiyla ‏{‏ adkhuluwa albaaba sujaadana waquwluwa hitaaaun yughfar lakum khataayaakum‏}‏ fabadaaluwa fadakhaluwa albaaba yazhafuwna 'alaa aastaahihim waqaaluwa habaaaun fiy sha'araain"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammim b. Munabbih reported:This is what Abu Huraira reported to us from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and in this connection he narrated some of the ahadith and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: It was said to people of Israel: Enter this land saying Hitta (Remove Thou from us the burden of our sins), whereupon We would forgive you your sins, but they twisted (this statement) and entered the gate dragging upon their breech and said: The" grain in the ear
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ النَّاقِدُ، وَالْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ، حُمَيْدٍ - قَالَ عَبْدٌ حَدَّثَنِي وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ كَيْسَانَ - عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ، مَالِكٍ أَنَّ اللَّهَ، عَزَّ وَجَلَّ تَابَعَ الْوَحْىَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَبْلَ وَفَاتِهِ حَتَّى تُوُفِّيَ وَأَكْثَرُ مَا كَانَ الْوَحْىُ يَوْمَ تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu muhammadi bni bukayrin alnnaaqidu, waalhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu, humaydin - qaala 'abdun haddathaniy waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'nuwna abna iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, - wahuwa abnu kaysaana - 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu, maalikin aanna alllaha, 'azza wajalla taaba'a alwahaa 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qabla wafaatihi hattaa tuwuffiya waaaktharu maa kaana alwahau yawma tuwuffiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, sent revelation to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) just before his death in quick succession until he left for his heavenly home, and the day when he died, he received the revelation profusely
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَارِقِ، بْنِ شِهَابٍ أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ، قَالُوا لِعُمَرَ إِنَّكُمْ تَقْرَءُونَ آيَةً لَوْ أُنْزِلَتْ فِينَا لاَتَّخَذْنَا ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ عِيدًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ حَيْثُ أُنْزِلَتْ وَأَىَّ يَوْمٍ أُنْزِلَتْ وَأَيْنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَيْثُ أُنْزِلَتْ أُنْزِلَتْ بِعَرَفَةَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاقِفٌ بِعَرَفَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ أَشُكُّ كَانَ يَوْمَ جُمُعَةٍ أَمْ لاَ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي ‏{‏ الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِي‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw khaythamaaa, zuhayru bnu harbin wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, - wahuwa abnu mahdiyyin - haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an qaysi bni muslimin, 'an taariqi, bni shihaabin aanna alyahuwda, qaaluwa li'umara iinnakum taqra'uwna ayaaan law aunzilat fiynaa laattakhadhnaa dhalika alyawma 'iydana ‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru iinniy laa'lamu haythu aunzilat waaaaaa yawmin aunzilat waaayna rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm haythu aunzilat aunzilat bi'arafaaa warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaqifun bi'arafaaa ‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu aashukku kaana yawma jumu'aain aam laa ‏.‏ ya'niy ‏{‏ alyawma aakmaltu lakum diynakum waaatmamtu 'alaykum ni'matiy‏}‏
verses.translation: Tariq b. Shihab reported that a Jew said to'Umar:You recite a verse which, if it had been revealed in relation to us, we would have taken that day as the day of rejoicing. Thereupon 'Umar said: I know where it was revealed and on the day when it was revealed and where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had been at that time when it was revealed. It was revealed on the day of 'Arafa (ninth of Dhu'l Hijjah) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had been staying in 'Arafat. Sufyan said: I doubt, whether it was Friday or not (and the verse referred to) is this:" Today I have perfected your religion for you and completed My favours upon you" (v)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ قَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ لِعُمَرَ لَوْ عَلَيْنَا مَعْشَرَ يَهُودَ نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِي وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ الإِسْلاَمَ دِينًا‏}‏ نَعْلَمُ الْيَوْمَ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَتْ فِيهِ لاَتَّخَذْنَا ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ عِيدًا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ فَقَدْ عَلِمْتُ الْيَوْمَ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَتْ فِيهِ وَالسَّاعَةَ وَأَيْنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ نَزَلَتْ نَزَلَتْ لَيْلَةَ جَمْعٍ وَنَحْنُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعَرَفَاتٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - qaala haddathanaa 'abdu, alllahi bnu iidriysa 'an aabiyhi, 'an qaysi bni muslimin, 'an taariqi bni shihaabin, qaala qaalati alyahuwdu li'umara law 'alaynaa ma'shara yahuwda nazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏ alyawma aakmaltu lakum diynakum waaatmamtu 'alaykum ni'matiy waradiytu lakumu aliislaama diynana‏}‏ na'lamu alyawma alladhiy aunzilat fiyhi laattakhadhnaa dhalika alyawma 'iydana ‏.‏ qaala faqaala 'umaru faqad 'alimtu alyawma alladhiy aunzilat fiyhi waalssaa'aaa waaayna rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna nazalat nazalat laylaaa jam'in wanahnu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bi'arafaatin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Tariq b. Shihab reported that a Jew said to 'Umar:If this verse were revealed in relation to the Jews (i e. "This day I have perfected your religion for you and have completed My favours for you and have chosen for you al-Islam as religion") we would have taken the day of rejoicing on which this verse was revealed. Thereupon 'Umar said: I know the day on which it was revealed and the hour when it was revealed and where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had been when it was revealed. It was revealed on the night of Friday and we were in 'Arafat with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at that time
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عُمَيْسٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ، بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ إِلَى عُمَرَ فَقَالَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ آيَةٌ فِي كِتَابِكُمْ تَقْرَءُونَهَا لَوْ عَلَيْنَا نَزَلَتْ مَعْشَرَ الْيَهُودِ لاَتَّخَذْنَا ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ عِيدًا ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَىُّ آيَةٍ قَالَ ‏{‏ الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِي وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ الإِسْلاَمَ دِينًا‏}‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ الْيَوْمَ الَّذِي نَزَلَتْ فِيهِ وَالْمَكَانَ الَّذِي نَزَلَتْ فِيهِ نَزَلَتْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعَرَفَاتٍ فِي يَوْمِ جُمُعَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa ja'faru bnu 'awnin, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'umaysin, 'an qaysi, bni muslimin 'an taariqi bni shihaabin, qaala jaa'a rajulun mina alyahuwdi iilaa 'umara faqaala yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna ayaaun fiy kitaabikum taqra'uwnahaa law 'alaynaa nazalat ma'shara alyahuwdi laattakhadhnaa dhalika alyawma 'iydana ‏.‏ qaala waaaaau ayaain qaala ‏{‏ alyawma aakmaltu lakum diynakum waaatmamtu 'alaykum ni'matiy waradiytu lakumu aliislaama diynana‏}‏ faqaala 'umaru iinniy laa'lamu alyawma alladhiy nazalat fiyhi waalmakaana alladhiy nazalat fiyhi nazalat 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bi'arafaatin fiy yawmi jumu'aain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Tariq b. Shihab reported that a Jew came to 'Umar and said:Commander of the Faithful, there is a verse in your Book, which you recite. Had it been revealed in connection with the Jews, we would have taken it as the day of rejoicing. Thereupon he said: Which verse do you mean? He replied:" This day I have perfected your religion for you and I have completed My favours upon you and I have chosen al-Islam as religion for you." Umar said, I know the day when it was revealed and the place where it was revealed. It was revealed to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at 'Arafat on Friday
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ - قَالَ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، حَرْمَلَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا - ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَائِشَةَ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ، ‏{‏ وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ، تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى فَانْكِحُوا مَا طَابَ لَكُمْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ مَثْنَى وَثُلاَثَ وَرُبَاعَ‏}‏ قَالَتْ يَا ابْنَ أُخْتِي هِيَ الْيَتِيمَةُ تَكُونُ فِي حَجْرِ وَلِيِّهَا تُشَارِكُهُ فِي مَالِهِ فَيُعْجِبُهُ مَالُهَا وَجَمَالُهَا فَيُرِيدُ وَلِيُّهَا أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَهَا بِغَيْرِ أَنْ يُقْسِطَ فِي صَدَاقِهَا فَيُعْطِيَهَا مِثْلَ مَا يُعْطِيهَا غَيْرُهُ فَنُهُوا أَنْ يَنْكِحُوهُنَّ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُقْسِطُوا لَهُنَّ وَيَبْلُغُوا بِهِنَّ أَعْلَى سُنَّتِهِنَّ مِنَ الصَّدَاقِ وَأُمِرُوا أَنْ يَنْكِحُوا مَا طَابَ لَهُمْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ سِوَاهُنَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ ثُمَّ إِنَّ النَّاسَ اسْتَفْتَوْا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ فِيهِنَّ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَيَسْتَفْتُونَكَ فِي النِّسَاءِ قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِيهِنَّ وَمَا يُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الْكِتَابِ فِي يَتَامَى النِّسَاءِ اللاَّتِي لاَ تُؤْتُونَهُنَّ مَا كُتِبَ لَهُنَّ وَتَرْغَبُونَ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ‏}‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَالَّذِي ذَكَرَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَنَّهُ يُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الْكِتَابِ الآيَةُ الأُولَى الَّتِي قَالَ اللَّهُ فِيهَا ‏{‏ وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى فَانْكِحُوا مَا طَابَ لَكُمْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ‏}‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَقَوْلُ اللَّهِ فِي الآيَةِ الأُخْرَى ‏{‏ وَتَرْغَبُونَ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ‏}‏ رَغْبَةَ أَحَدِكُمْ عَنِ الْيَتِيمَةِ الَّتِي تَكُونُ فِي حَجْرِهِ حِينَ تَكُونُ قَلِيلَةَ الْمَالِ وَالْجَمَالِ فَنُهُوا أَنْ يَنْكِحُوا مَا رَغِبُوا فِي مَالِهَا وَجَمَالِهَا مِنْ يَتَامَى النِّسَاءِ إِلاَّ بِالْقِسْطِ مِنْ أَجْلِ رَغْبَتِهِمْ عَنْهُنَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amriw bni sarhin waharmalaau bnu yahyaa alttujiybiyyu - qaala aabuw alttaahiri haddathanaa waqaala, harmalaau aakhbaranaa - abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aannahu saaala 'aaiishaaa 'an qawli alllahi, ‏{‏ waiin khiftum aan laa, tuqsituwa fiy alyataamaa faankihuwa maa taaba lakum mina alnnisaa'i mathnaa wathulaatha warubaa'a‏}‏ qaalat yaa abna aukhtiy hiya alyatiymaau takuwnu fiy hajri waliyyihaa tushaarikuhu fiy maalihi fayu'jibuhu maaluhaa wajamaaluhaa fayuriydu waliyyuhaa aan yatazawwajahaa bighayri aan yuqsita fiy sadaaqihaa fayu'tiyahaa mithla maa yu'tiyhaa ghayruhu fanuhuwa aan yankihuwhunna iilaaa aan yuqsituwa lahunna wayablughuwa bihinna aa'laa sunnatihinna mina alssadaaqi waaumiruwa aan yankihuwa maa taaba lahum mina alnnisaa'i siwaahunna ‏.‏ qaala 'urwaau qaalat 'aaiishaau thumma iinna alnnaasa astaftawa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da hadhihi alayaai fiyhinna faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ wayastaftuwnaka fiy alnnisaa'i quli alllahu yuftiykum fiyhinna wamaa yutlaa 'alaykum fiy alkitaabi fiy yataamaa alnnisaa'i allaaatiy laa tuutuwnahunna maa kutiba lahunna watarghabuwna aan tankihuwhunna‏}‏ ‏.‏ qaalat waalladhiy dhakara alllahu ta'aalaa aannahu yutlaa 'alaykum fiy alkitaabi alayaau alauwlaa allatiy qaala alllahu fiyhaa ‏{‏ waiin khiftum aan laa tuqsituwa fiy alyataamaa faankihuwa maa taaba lakum mina alnnisaa'i‏}‏ ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau waqawlu alllahi fiy alayaai alaukhraa ‏{‏ watarghabuwna aan tankihuwhunna‏}‏ raghbaaa aahadikum 'ani alyatiymaai allatiy takuwnu fiy hajrihi hiyna takuwnu qaliylaaa almaali waaljamaali fanuhuwa aan yankihuwa maa raghibuwa fiy maalihaa wajamaalihaa min yataamaa alnnisaa'i iilaaa bialqisti min aajli raghbatihim 'anhunna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Urwa b. Zubair reported that he asked 'A'isha about the words of Allah:" If you fear that you will not be able to maintain equity amongst the orphan girls, then marry (those) you like from amongst the women two, three or four." She said: O, the son of my sister, the orphan girl is one who is under the patronage of her guardian and she shares with him in his property and her property and beauty fascinate him and her guardian makes up his mind to marry her without giving her due share of the wedding money and is not prepared (to pay so much amount) which anyone else is prepared to pay and so Allah has forbidden to marry these girls but in case when equity is observed as regards the wedding money and they are prepared to pay them the full amount of the wedding money and Allah commanded to marry other women besides them according to the liking of their heart. 'Urwa reported that 'A'isha said that people began to seek verdict from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) after the revelation of this verse about them (orphan girls) and Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed this verse:" They asked thee verdict about women; say: Allah gives verdict to you in regard to them and what is recited to you in the Book about orphan woman, whom you give not what is ordained for them while you like to marry them" (iv. 126). She said: The wording of Allah" what is recited to you" in the Book means the first verse, i. e." if you fear that you may not be able to observe equity in case of an orphan woman, marry what you like in case of woman" (iv. 3). 'A'isha said: (And as for this verse [iv. 126], i. e. and you intend" to marry one of them from amongst the orphan girls" it pertains to one who is in charge (of orphans) having small amount of wealth and less beauty and they have been forbidden that they should marry what they like of her wealth and beauty out of the orphan girls, but with equity, because of their disliking for them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَائِشَةَ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ، ‏{‏وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ، تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى‏}‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ وَزَادَ فِي آخِرِهِ مِنْ أَجْلِ رَغْبَتِهِمْ عَنْهُنَّ إِذَا كُنَّ قَلِيلاَتِ الْمَالِ وَالْجَمَالِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa alhasanu alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, jamiy'ana 'an ya'quwba bni iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'urwaau, aannahu saaala 'aaiishaaa 'an qawli alllahi, ‏{‏waiin khiftum aan laa, tuqsituwa fiy alyataamaa‏}‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bimithli hadiythi yuwnusa 'ani alzzuhriyyi wazaada fiy akhirihi min aajli raghbatihim 'anhunna iidhaa kunna qaliylaati almaali waaljamaali ‏.‏
verses.translation: Urwa reported that he asked 'A'isha about the words of Allah:" If you fear that you will not be able to observe equity in case of orphan girls" ; the rest of the hadith is the same but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، فِي قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏ وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى‏}‏ قَالَتْ أُنْزِلَتْ فِي الرَّجُلِ تَكُونُ لَهُ الْيَتِيمَةُ وَهُوَ وَلِيُّهَا وَوَارِثُهَا وَلَهَا مَالٌ وَلَيْسَ لَهَا أَحَدٌ يُخَاصِمُ دُونَهَا فَلاَ يُنْكِحُهَا لِمَالِهَا فَيَضُرُّ بِهَا وَيُسِيءُ صُحْبَتَهَا فَقَالَ ‏{‏ إِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى فَانْكِحُوا مَا طَابَ لَكُمْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ‏}‏ يَقُولُ مَا أَحْلَلْتُ لَكُمْ وَدَعْ هَذِهِ الَّتِي تَضُرُّ بِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, fiy qawlihi ‏{‏ waiin khiftum aan laa tuqsituwa fiy alyataamaa‏}‏ qaalat aunzilat fiy alrrajuli takuwnu lahu alyatiymaau wahuwa waliyyuhaa wawaarithuhaa walahaa maalun walaysa lahaa aahadun yukhaasimu duwnahaa falaa yunkihuhaa limaalihaa fayadurru bihaa wayusiy'u suhbatahaa faqaala ‏{‏ iin khiftum aan laa tuqsituwa fiy alyataamaa faankihuwa maa taaba lakum mina alnnisaa'i‏}‏ yaquwlu maa aahlaltu lakum wada' hadhihi allatiy tadurru bihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: (A'isha said that as for the words of Allah:" If you fear that you would not be able to observe equity in case of orphan girls)," it was revealed in reference to a person who had an orphan girl (as his ward) and he was her guardian, and her heir, and she possessed property, but there was none to contend on her behalf except her ownself. And he (her guardian) did not give her in marriage because of her property and he tortured her and ill-treated her, it was in relation to her that (Allah said: )" If you fear that you would not be able to observe equity in case of orphan girls, then marry whom you like among women," i. e. whatever I have made lawful for you and leave her whom you are putting to torture
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، فِي قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏ وَمَا يُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الْكِتَابِ فِي يَتَامَى النِّسَاءِ اللاَّتِي لاَ تُؤْتُونَهُنَّ مَا كُتِبَ لَهُنَّ وَتَرْغَبُونَ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ‏}‏ قَالَتْ أُنْزِلَتْ فِي الْيَتِيمَةِ تَكُونُ عِنْدَ الرَّجُلِ فَتَشْرَكُهُ فِي مَالِهِ فَيَرْغَبُ عَنْهَا أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَهَا وَيَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُزَوِّجَهَا غَيْرَهُ فَيَشْرَكُهُ فِي مَالِهِ فَيَعْضِلُهَا فَلاَ يَتَزَوَّجُهَا وَلاَ يُزَوِّجُهَا غَيْرَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, fiy qawlihi ‏{‏ wamaa yutlaa 'alaykum fiy alkitaabi fiy yataamaa alnnisaa'i allaaatiy laa tuutuwnahunna maa kutiba lahunna watarghabuwna aan tankihuwhunna‏}‏ qaalat aunzilat fiy alyatiymaai takuwnu 'inda alrrajuli fatashrakuhu fiy maalihi fayarghabu 'anhaa aan yatazawwajahaa wayakrahu aan yuzawwijahaa ghayrahu fayashrakuhu fiy maalihi faya'diluhaa falaa yatazawwajuhaa walaa yuzawwijuhaa ghayrahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha said in connection with His words (those of Allah):" What is recited to you in the Book about orphan women whom you give not what is ordained for them, while you like to marry them," these were revealed in connection with an orphan girl who was in the charge of the person and she shared with him in his property and he was reluctant to marry her himself and was also unwilling to marry her to someone else (fearing) that (that person) would share in his property (as the husband of that girl), preventing her to marry, neither marrying her himself nor marrying her to another person
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، فِي قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏ ويَسْتَفْتُونَكَ فِي النِّسَاءِ قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِيهِنَّ‏}‏ الآيَةَ قَالَتْ هِيَ الْيَتِيمَةُ الَّتِي تَكُونُ عِنْدَ الرَّجُلِ لَعَلَّهَا أَنْ تَكُونَ قَدْ شَرِكَتْهُ فِي مَالِهِ حَتَّى فِي الْعَذْقِ فَيَرْغَبُ يَعْنِي أَنْ يَنْكِحَهَا وَيَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُنْكِحَهَا رَجُلاً فَيَشْرَكُهُ فِي مَالِهِ فَيَعْضِلُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, fiy qawlihi ‏{‏ wyastaftuwnaka fiy alnnisaa'i quli alllahu yuftiykum fiyhinna‏}‏ alayaaa qaalat hiya alyatiymaau allatiy takuwnu 'inda alrrajuli la'allahaa aan takuwna qad sharikathu fiy maalihi hattaa fiy al'adhqi fayarghabu ya'niy aan yankihahaa wayakrahu aan yunkihahaa rajulaan fayashrakuhu fiy maalihi faya'diluhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hisham reported that 'A'isha said in connection with the words of Allah:" They ask thee the religious verdict about women, say: Allah gives you the verdict about them" (iv. 126), that these relate to an orphan girl who is in charge of the person and she shares with him in his property (as a heir) even in the date-palm trees and he is reluctant to give her hand in marriage to any other person lest he (her husband) should partake of his property, and thus keep her in a lingering state
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، فِي قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏ وَمَنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ‏}‏ قَالَتْ أُنْزِلَتْ فِي وَالِي مَالِ الْيَتِيمِ الَّذِي يَقُومُ عَلَيْهِ وَيُصْلِحُهُ إِذَا كَانَ مُحْتَاجًا أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, fiy qawlihi ‏{‏ waman kaana faqiyrana falyaakul bialma'ruwfi‏}‏ qaalat aunzilat fiy waaliy maali alyatiymi alladhiy yaquwmu 'alayhi wayuslihuhu iidhaa kaana muhtaajana aan yaakula minhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hisham reported on the authority of his father that 'A'isha said in connection with His (Allah's) words:" And whoever is poor let him take reasonably (out of it)" that it was revealed in connection with the custodian of the property of an orphan, who is in charge of her and looks after her; In case he is poor, he is allowed to eat out of that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏ وَمَنْ كَانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ وَمَنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ‏}‏ قَالَتْ أُنْزِلَتْ فِي وَلِيِّ الْيَتِيمِ أَنْ يُصِيبَ مِنْ مَالِهِ إِذَا كَانَ مُحْتَاجًا بِقَدْرِ مَالِهِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, fiy qawlihi ta'aalaa ‏{‏ waman kaana ghaniyyana falyasta'fif waman kaana faqiyrana falyaakul bialma'ruwfi‏}‏ qaalat aunzilat fiy waliyyi alyatiymi aan yusiyba min maalihi iidhaa kaana muhtaajana biqadri maalihi bialma'ruwfi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported in connection with the words of Allah, the Exalted:" He who is rich should abstain, and he who is poor may reasonably eat (out of it)" that this was revealed in relation to the guardian of an orphan who is poor; he may get out of that what is reasonable keeping in view his own status of solvency
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ إِذْ جَاءُوكُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ الأَبْصَارُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ‏}‏ قَالَتْ كَانَ ذَلِكَ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, fiy qawlihi 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ iidh jaa'uwkum min fawqikum wamin aasfala minkum waiidh zaaghati alaabsaaru wabalaghati alquluwbu alhanaajira‏}‏ qaalat kaana dhalika yawma alkhandaqi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that these words of Allah:" When they came upon you from above you and from below you and when the eyes turned dull and the hearts rose up to the throats" (xxxiii. 10) pertain to the day of Ditch
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، ‏{‏ وَإِنِ امْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنْ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا أَوْ إِعْرَاضًا‏}‏ الآيَةَ قَالَتْ أُنْزِلَتْ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَكُونُ عِنْدَ الرَّجُلِ فَتَطُولُ صُحْبَتُهَا فَيُرِيدُ طَلاَقَهَا فَتَقُولُ لاَ تُطَلِّقْنِي وَأَمْسِكْنِي وَأَنْتَ فِي حِلٍّ مِنِّي ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, ‏{‏ waiini amraaaaun khaafat min ba'lihaa nushuwzana aaw ii'raadana‏}‏ alayaaa qaalat aunzilat fiy almaraaai takuwnu 'inda alrrajuli fatatuwlu suhbatuhaa fayuriydu talaaqahaa fataquwlu laa tutalliqniy waaamsikniy waaanta fiy hillin minniy ‏.‏ fanazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha said in connection with the verse:" And if a woman has reason to fear ill-treatment from her husband or that he might turn away from her" (iv. 128) that it was revealed in case of a woman who had long association with a person (as his wife) and now he intends to divorce her and she says: Do not divorce me, but retain me (as wife in your house) and you are permitted to live with another wife. It is in this context that this verse was revealed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَإِنِ امْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنْ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا أَوْ إِعْرَاضًا‏}‏ قَالَتْ نَزَلَتْ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَكُونُ عِنْدَ الرَّجُلِ فَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ لاَ يَسْتَكْثِرَ مِنْهَا وَتَكُونُ لَهَا صُحْبَةٌ وَوَلَدٌ فَتَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُفَارِقَهَا فَتَقُولُ لَهُ أَنْتَ فِي حِلٍّ مِنْ شَأْنِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, fiy qawlihi 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ waiini amraaaaun khaafat min ba'lihaa nushuwzana aaw ii'raadana‏}‏ qaalat nazalat fiy almaraaai takuwnu 'inda alrrajuli fala'allahu aan laa yastakthira minhaa watakuwnu lahaa suhbaaun wawaladun fatakrahu aan yufaariqahaa fataquwlu lahu aanta fiy hillin min shaaniy ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha said in connection with these words of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious:" And if a woman has reason to fear ill-treatment from her husband or that he might turn away from her" that it was revealed in case of a woman who lived with a person and perhaps he does not want to prolong (his relationship with her) whereas she has had sexual relationship with him (and as a result thereof) she got a child from him and she does not like that she should be divorced, so she says to him: I permit you to live with the other wife
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَتْ لِي عَائِشَةُ يَا ابْنَ أُخْتِي أُمِرُوا أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُوا، لأَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَبُّوهُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaalat liy 'aaiishaau yaa abna aukhtiy aumiruwa aan yastaghfiruwa, laashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasabbuwhum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Urwa reported on the authority of his father that 'A'isha said to him:O, the son of my sister, the Muslims were commanded to seek forgiveness for the Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) but they reviled them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Usama with the same chain of narrators
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ اخْتَلَفَ أَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ فِي هَذِهِ الآيَةِ ‏{‏ وَمَنْ يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاؤُهُ جَهَنَّمُ‏}‏ فَرَحَلْتُ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهَا فَقَالَ لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَتْ آخِرَ مَا أُنْزِلَ ثُمَّ مَا نَسَخَهَا شَىْءٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani almughiyraai bni alnnu'maani, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala akhtalafa aahlu alkuwfaai fiy hadhihi alayaai ‏{‏ waman yaqtul muuminana muta'ammidana fajazaauuhu jahannamu‏}‏ farahaltu iilaa abni 'abbaasin fasaaaltuhu 'anhaa faqaala laqad aunzilat akhira maa aunzila thumma maa nasakhahaa shaa'un ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported:The inhabitants of Kufa differed in regard to this verse:" But whoever slays another believer intentionally, his requital shall be Hell" (iv. 92), so I went to Ibn 'Abbas and asked him about it, whereupon he said: This has been revealed and nothing abrogated it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ، قَالاَ جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ فِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ جَعْفَرٍ نَزَلَتْ فِي آخِرِ مَا أُنْزِلَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ النَّضْرِ إِنَّهَا لَمِنْ آخِرِ مَا أُنْزِلَتْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma aakhbaranaa alnnadru, qaalaa jamiy'ana haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ fiy hadiythi abni ja'farin nazalat fiy akhiri maa aunzila ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi alnnadri iinnahaa lamin akhiri maa aunzilat ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of narrators but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ أَمَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبْزَى أَنْ أَسْأَلَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ هَاتَيْنِ الآيَتَيْنِ، ‏{‏ وَمَنْ يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاؤُهُ جَهَنَّمُ خَالِدًا فِيهَا‏}‏ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ لَمْ يَنْسَخْهَا شَىْءٌ ‏.‏ وَعَنْ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ ‏{‏ وَالَّذِينَ لاَ يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ وَلاَ يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ‏}‏ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِي أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mansuwrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala aamaraniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu aabzaa aan aasaala abna 'abbaasin, 'an haatayni alayatayni, ‏{‏ waman yaqtul muuminana muta'ammidana fajazaauuhu jahannamu khaalidana fiyhaa‏}‏ fasaaaltuhu faqaala lam yansakhhaa shaa'un ‏.‏ wa'an hadhihi alayaai ‏{‏ waalladhiyna laa yad'uwna ma'a alllahi iilahana akhara walaa yaqtuluwna alnnafsa allatiy harrama alllahu iilaaa bialhaqqi‏}‏ qaala nazalat fiy aahli alshhirki ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported:'Abd al Rahman b. Abzi commanded me that I should ask Ibn 'Abbas about these two verses:" He who slays a believer intentionally his requital shall be Hell where he would abide for ever" (iv. 92). So, I asked him and he said: Nothing has abrogated it. And as for this verse:" And they who call not upon another god with Allah and slay not the soul which Allah has forbidden, except in the cause of justice" (xxv. 68), he (Ibn Abbas) said: This has been revealed in regard to the polytheists
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ، هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ اللَّيْثِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، - يَعْنِي شَيْبَانَ - عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ الْمُعْتَمِرِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،قَالَ نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ بِمَكَّةَ ‏{‏ وَالَّذِينَ لاَ يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏ مُهَانًا‏}‏ فَقَالَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنَّا الإِسْلاَمُ وَقَدْ عَدَلْنَا بِاللَّهِ وَقَدْ قَتَلْنَا النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَأَتَيْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ إِلاَّ مَنْ تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلاً صَالِحًا‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَمَّا مَنْ دَخَلَ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ وَعَقَلَهُ ثُمَّ قَتَلَ فَلاَ تَوْبَةَ لَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi allaahi, hadaathanaa aabuw alnaadri, haashimu bnu alqaasimi allaaythiyuu hadaathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, - ya'niy shaybaana - 'an mansuwri bni almu'tamiri, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abaaasin, qaala nazalat hadhihi alayaau bimakaaaa ‏{‏ waalaadhiyna laa yad'uwna ma'a allaahi iilahana akhara‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏ muhaanana‏}‏ faqaala almushrikuwna wamaa yughniy 'anaaa aliislaamu waqad 'adalnaa biallaahi waqad qatalnaa alnaafsa alaatiy haraama allaahu waaataynaa alfawaahisha faaanzala allaahu 'azaa wajalaa ‏{‏ iilaaa man taaba waamana wa'amila 'amalaan saalihana‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai ‏.‏ qaala faaamaaa man dakhala fiy aliislaami wa'aqalahu thumaa qatala falaa tawbaaa lahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas said:This verse was revealed in Mecca:" And they who call not upon another god with Allah and slay not the soul which Allah has forbidden except in the cause of justice" up to the word Muhdana (abased). Thereupon the polytheists said: Islam is of no avail to us for we have made peer with Allah and we killed the soul which Allah had forbidden to do and we committed debauchery, and it was (on this occasion) that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed this verse:" Except him who repents and believes and does good deeds" up to the end Ibn 'Abbis says: He who enters the fold of Islam and understands its command and then kills the soul there is no repentance for him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ أَبِي بَزَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَلِمَنْ قَتَلَ مُؤْمِنًا مُتَعَمِّدًا مِنْ تَوْبَةٍ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَلَوْتُ عَلَيْهِ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ الَّتِي فِي الْفُرْقَانِ ‏{‏ وَالَّذِينَ لاَ يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ وَلاَ يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ هَذِهِ آيَةٌ مَكِّيَّةٌ نَسَخَتْهَا آيَةٌ مَدَنِيَّةٌ ‏{‏ وَمَنْ يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاؤُهُ جَهَنَّمُ خَالِدًا‏}‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ هَاشِمٍ فَتَلَوْتُ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ الَّتِي فِي الْفُرْقَانِ‏{‏ إِلاَّ مَنْ تَابَ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu haashimin, wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu bishrin al'abdiyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa abnu sa'iydin alqattaanu - 'ani abni jurayjin, haddathaniy alqaasimu bnu aabiy bazzaaa, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala qultu laibni 'abbaasin aaliman qatala muuminana muta'ammidana min tawbaain qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala fatalawtu 'alayhi hadhihi alayaaa allatiy fiy alfurqaani ‏{‏ waalladhiyna laa yad'uwna ma'a alllahi iilahana akhara walaa yaqtuluwna alnnafsa allatiy harrama alllahu iilaaa bialhaqqi‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai ‏.‏ qaala hadhihi ayaaun makkiyyaaun nasakhathaa ayaaun madaniyyaaun ‏{‏ waman yaqtul muuminana muta'ammidana fajazaauuhu jahannamu khaalidana‏}‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni haashimin fatalawtu hadhihi alayaaa allatiy fiy alfurqaani‏{‏ iilaaa man taaba‏}‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported:I said to Ibn Abbas: Will the repentance of that person be accepted who kills a believer intentionally? He said: No. I recited to him this verse of Sura al-Furqan (xix.):" And those who call not upon another god with Allah and slay not the soul which Allah has forbidden except in the cause of justice" to the end of the verse. He said: This is a Meccan verse which has been abrogated by a verse revealed at Medina:" He who slays a believer intentionally, for him is the requital of Hell-Fire where he would abide for ever," and in the narration of Ibn Hisham (the words are): I recited to him this verse of Sura al-Furqan:" Except one who made repentance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عُمَيْسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ بْنِ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ لِيَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ تَعْلَمُ - وَقَالَ هَارُونُ تَدْرِي - آخِرَ سُورَةٍ نَزَلَتْ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ نَزَلَتْ جَمِيعًا قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ ‏{‏ إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ‏}‏ قَالَ صَدَقْتَ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ تَعْلَمُ أَىُّ سُورَةٍ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ آخِرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wahaaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa ja'faru bnu 'awnin, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'umaysin, 'an 'abdi almajiydi bni suhaylin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, qaala qaala liya abnu 'abbaasin ta'lamu - waqaala haaruwnu tadriy - akhira suwraain nazalat mina alqurani nazalat jamiy'ana qultu na'am ‏.‏ ‏{‏ iidhaa jaa'a nasru alllahi waalfathu‏}‏ qaala sadaqta ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni aabiy shaybaaa ta'lamu aaaau suwraain ‏.‏ walam yaqul akhira ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubaidullah b. 'Abdullah b. 'Utba reported:Ibn Abbas said to me: Do you know-and in the words of Harun (another narrator): Are you aware of-the last Sura which was revealed in the Qur'an as a whole? I said: Yes," When came the help from Allah and the victory" (cx.). Thereupon, he said: You have told the truth. And in the narration of Abu Shaiba (the words are): Do you know the Sura? And he did not mention the words" the last one
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَيْسٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ وَقَالَ آخِرَ سُورَةٍ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الْمَجِيدِ وَلَمْ يَقُلِ ابْنِ سُهَيْلٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa aabuw 'umaysin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu waqaala akhira suwraain waqaala 'abdu almajiydi walam yaquli abni suhaylin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu 'Umais through the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ الضَّبِّيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَقِيَ نَاسٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ رَجُلاً فِي غُنَيْمَةٍ لَهُ فَقَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ ‏.‏ فَأَخَذُوهُ فَقَتَلُوهُ وَأَخَذُوا تِلْكَ الْغُنَيْمَةَ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ وَلاَ تَقُولُوا لِمَنْ أَلْقَى إِلَيْكُمُ السَّلَمَ لَسْتَ مُؤْمِنًا‏}‏ وَقَرَأَهَا ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ السَّلاَمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waaahmadu bnu 'abdaaa alddabbiyyu, - waalllafzu laibni aabiy shaybaaa - qaala haddathanaa waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala laqiya naasun mina almuslimiyna rajulaan fiy ghunaymaain lahu faqaala alssalaamu 'alaykum ‏.‏ faaakhadhuwhu faqataluwhu waaakhadhuwa tilka alghunaymaaa fanazalat ‏{‏ walaa taquwluwa liman aalqaa iilaykumu alssalama lasta muuminana‏}‏ waqaraaahaa abnu 'abbaasin alssalaama ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that some Muslims met a person with a small flock of sheep. He said:As-Salam-o-'Alaikum. They caught hold of him and killed him and took possession of his flock. Then this verse was revealed:" He who meets you and extends you salutations, don't say: You are not a Muslim" (iv. 94). Ibn 'Abbas, however, recited the word as-Salam instead of" as-Salam
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، يَقُولُ كَانَتِ الأَنْصَارُ إِذَا حَجُّوا فَرَجَعُوا لَمْ يَدْخُلُوا الْبُيُوتَ إِلاَّ مِنْ ظُهُورِهَا - قَالَ - فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَدَخَلَ مِنْ بَابِهِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ فِي ذَلِكَ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏وَلَيْسَ الْبِرُّ بِأَنْ تَأْتُوا الْبُيُوتَ مِنْ ظُهُورِهَا‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a, yaquwlu kaanati alaansaaru iidhaa hajjuwa faraja'uwa lam yadkhuluwa albuyuwta iilaaa min zuhuwrihaa - qaala - fajaa'a rajulun mina alaansaari fadakhala min baabihi faqiyla lahu fiy dhalika fanazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏walaysa albirru biaan taatuwa albuyuwta min zuhuwrihaa‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Bara' reported:When the Ansar performed the Pilgrimage, they did not enter their houses but from behind. A person from the Ansar came and he began to enter from his door but it was said to him (why he was doing something in contravention to the common practice of coming to the houses from behind). Then this verse was revealed." Piety is not that you come to the doors from behind" (ii)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى الصَّدَفِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو، بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ مَا كَانَ بَيْنَ إِسْلاَمِنَا وَبَيْنَ أَنْ عَاتَبَنَا اللَّهُ بِهَذِهِ الآيَةِ ‏{‏ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنْ تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ‏}‏ إِلاَّ أَرْبَعُ سِنِينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yuwnusu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa alssadafiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw, bnu alhaarithi 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy hilaalin, 'an 'awni bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiyhi, aanna abna mas'uwdin, qaala maa kaana bayna iislaaminaa wabayna aan 'aatabanaa alllahu bihadhihi alayaai ‏{‏ aalam yaani lilladhiyna amanuwa aan takhsha'a quluwbuhum lidhikri alllahi‏}‏ iilaaa aarba'u siniyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Mas'ud said:Since our acceptance of Islam and the revelation of this verse in which Allah has shown annoyance to us:" Has not the time yet come for the believers that their hearts should be humble for the remembrance of Allah?" (lvii. 16), there was a gap of four years
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ الْبَطِينِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ، جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ تَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ وَهِيَ عُرْيَانَةٌ فَتَقُولُ مَنْ يُعِيرُنِي تِطْوَافًا تَجْعَلُهُ عَلَى فَرْجِهَا وَتَقُولُ الْيَوْمَ يَبْدُو بَعْضُهُ أَوْ كُلُّهُ فَمَا بَدَا مِنْهُ فَلاَ أُحِلُّهُ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏{‏ خُذُوا زِينَتَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, h wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu naafi'in, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an salamaaa bni kuhaylin, 'an muslimin albatiyni, 'an sa'iydi bni, jubayrin 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala kaanati almaraaau tatuwfu bialbayti wahiya 'uryaanaaun fataquwlu man yu'iyruniy titwaafana taj'aluhu 'alaa farjihaa wataquwlu alyawma yabduw ba'duhu aaw kulluhu famaa badaa minhu falaa auhilluhu fanazalat hadhihi alayaaa ‏{‏ khudhuwa ziynatakum 'inda kulli masjidin‏}‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported:During the pre-Islamic days women circumambulated the Ka'ba nakedly, and said: Who would provide cloth to cover the one who is circumambulating the Ka'ba so that she would cover her private parts? And then she would say: Today will be exposed the whole or the part and what is exposed I shall not make it lawful. It was in this connection that the verse was revealed:" Adorn yourself at every place of worship" (vii)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ ابْنُ سَلُولَ يَقُولُ لِجَارِيَةٍ لَهُ اذْهَبِي فَابْغِينَا شَيْئًا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَلاَ تُكْرِهُوا فَتَيَاتِكُمْ عَلَى الْبِغَاءِ إِنْ أَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّنًا لِتَبْتَغُوا عَرَضَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَنْ يُكْرِهْهُنَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ مِنْ بَعْدِ إِكْرَاهِهِنَّ‏}‏ لَهُنَّ ‏{‏ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin jamiy'ana 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, - waalllafzu laabiy kuraybin - haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala kaana 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain abnu saluwla yaquwlu lijaariyaain lahu adhhabiy faabghiynaa shayiana faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ walaa tukrihuwa fatayaatikum 'alaa albighaa'i iin aaradna tahassunana litabtaghuwa 'arada alhayaaai alddunyaa waman yukrihhunna faiinna alllaha min ba'di iikraahihinna‏}‏ lahunna ‏{‏ ghafuwrun rahiymun‏}‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that 'Abdullah b. Ubayy b. Salul used to say to his slave-girl:Go and fetch something for us by committing prostitution. It was in this connection that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed this verse:" And compel not your slave-girls to prostitution when they desire to keep chaste in order to seek the frail goods of this world's life, and whoever compels them, then surely after their compulsion Allah is Forgiving, Merciful" (xxiv)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ جَارِيَةً، لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُبَىٍّ ابْنِ سَلُولَ يُقَالُ لَهَا مُسَيْكَةُ وَأُخْرَى يُقَالُ لَهَا أُمَيْمَةُ فَكَانَ يُكْرِهُهُمَا عَلَى الزِّنَى فَشَكَتَا ذَلِكَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏ وَلاَ تُكْرِهُوا فَتَيَاتِكُمْ عَلَى الْبِغَاءِ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ‏}‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, aanna jaariyaaan, li'abdi alllahi bni aubaaain abni saluwla yuqaalu lahaa musaykaau waaukhraa yuqaalu lahaa aumaymaau fakaana yukrihuhumaa 'alaa alzzinaa fashakataa dhalika iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏ walaa tukrihuwa fatayaatikum 'alaa albighaa'i‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏ ghafuwrun rahiymun‏}‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that 'Abdullah b. Ubayy b. Salul had two slave-girls; one was called Musaika and the other one was called Umaima and he compelled them to prostitution (for which'Abdullah b. Ubayy b. Salul compelled them). They made a complaint about this to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and it was upon this that this verse was revealed:" And compel not your slave-girls to prostitute" up to the words:" Allah is Forgiving, Merciful
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَى رَبِّهِمُ الْوَسِيلَةَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ‏}‏ قَالَ كَانَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ أَسْلَمُوا وَكَانُوا يُعْبَدُونَ فَبَقِيَ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ عَلَى عِبَادَتِهِمْ وَقَدْ أَسْلَمَ النَّفَرُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an aabiy ma'marin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, fiy qawlihi 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ auwlaiika alladhiyna yad'uwna yabtaghuwna iilaa rabbihimu alwasiylaaa aayyuhum aaqrabu‏}‏ qaala kaana nafarun mina aljinni aaslamuwa wakaanuwa yu'baduwna fabaqiya alladhiyna kaanuwa ya'buduwna 'alaa 'ibaadatihim waqad aaslama alnnafaru mina aljinni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported in connection with the words of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious:" Those to whom they call upon, themselves seek the means or access to their Lord as to whoever of them becomes nearest" (xvii. 57) that it related to a party of Jinn who were being worshipped and they embraced Islam but those who worshipped them kept on worshipping them (though the Jinn whom the misguided people worshipped had become Muslims). It was then that this verse was revealed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ الزِّمَّانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، مَسْعُودٍ ‏{‏ أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَى رَبِّهِمُ الْوَسِيلَةَ‏}‏ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِي نَفَرٍ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ نَفَرًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَأَسْلَمَ الْجِنِّيُّونَ وَالإِنْسُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَهُمْ لاَ يَشْعُرُونَ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَى رَبِّهِمُ الْوَسِيلَةَ‏}‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi bnu 'abdi alwaarithi, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa husaynun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni ma'badin alzzimmaaniyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, mas'uwdin ‏{‏ auwlaiika alladhiyna yad'uwna yabtaghuwna iilaa rabbihimu alwasiylaaa‏}‏ qaala nazalat fiy nafarin mina al'arabi kaanuwa ya'buduwna nafarana mina aljinni faaaslama aljinniyyuwna waaliinsu alladhiyna kaanuwa ya'buduwnahum laa yash'uruwna fanazalat ‏{‏ auwlaiika alladhiyna yad'uwna yabtaghuwna iilaa rabbihimu alwasiylaaa‏}‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Mas'ud said in connection with the verse:" Those whom they call upon, themselves seek the means of access to their Lord," that that verse was revealed in connection with a party of Arabs who used to worship a group amnogst the jinn; the jinn embraced Islam but the people kept worshipping them without being conscious of it. Then this verse was revealed:" Those whom they call upon, themselves seek the means of access to their Lord
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُطِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ سُورَةُ التَّوْبَةِ قَالَ آلتَّوْبَةِ قَالَ بَلْ هِيَ الْفَاضِحَةُ مَا زَالَتْ تَنْزِلُ وَمِنْهُمْ وَمِنْهُمْ ‏.‏ حَتَّى ظَنُّوا أَنْ لاَ يَبْقَى مِنَّا أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ ذُكِرَ فِيهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ سُورَةُ الأَنْفَالِ قَالَ تِلْكَ سُورَةُ بَدْرٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ فَالْحَشْرُ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِي بَنِي النَّضِيرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu mutiy'in, haddathanaa hushaymun, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala qultu laibni 'abbaasin suwraau alttawbaai qaala alttawbaai qaala bal hiya alfaadihaau maa zaalat tanzilu waminhum waminhum ‏.‏ hattaa zannuwa aan laa yabqaa minnaa aahadun iilaaa dhukira fiyhaa ‏.‏ qaala qultu suwraau alaanfaali qaala tilka suwraau badrin ‏.‏ qaala qultu faalhashru qaala nazalat fiy baniy alnnadiyri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported:I said to Ibn 'Abbas about Sura Tauba, whereupon he said: As for Sura Tauba, it is meant to humiliate (the non-believers and the hypocrites). There is constantly revealed in it (the pronoun) minhum (of them) and minhom (of them, i. e. such is the condition of some of them) till they (the Muslims) thought that none would be left unmentioned out of them who would not be blamed (for one fault or the other). I again said: What about Sura Anfal? He said: It pertains to the Battle of Badr. I again asked him about Sura al-Hashr. He said: It was revealed in connection with (the tribe) of Banu Nadir
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّانَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ خَطَبَ عُمَرُ عَلَى مِنْبَرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَمَّا بَعْدُ أَلاَ وَإِنَّ الْخَمْرَ نَزَلَ تَحْرِيمُهَا يَوْمَ نَزَلَ وَهْىَ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ أَشْيَاءَ مِنَ الْحِنْطَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَالْعَسَلِ ‏.‏ وَالْخَمْرُ مَا خَامَرَ الْعَقْلَ وَثَلاَثَةُ أَشْيَاءَ وَدِدْتُ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ عَهِدَ إِلَيْنَا فِيهَا الْجَدُّ وَالْكَلاَلَةُ وَأَبْوَابٌ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الرِّبَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an aabiy hayyaana, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala khataba 'umaru 'alaa minbari rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi thumma qaala aammaa ba'du aalaa waiinna alkhamra nazala tahriymuhaa yawma nazala wahaa min khamsaai aashyaa'a mina alhintaai waalshha'iyri waalttamri waalzzabiybi waal'asali ‏.‏ waalkhamru maa khaamara al'aqla wathalaathaau aashyaa'a wadidtu aayyuhaa alnnaasu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana 'ahida iilaynaa fiyhaa aljaddu waalkalaalaau waaabwaabun min aabwaabi alrribaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that Umar delivered a sermon on the pulpit of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he praised Allah and lauded Him and then said:Now coming to the point. Behold I when the command pertaining to the prohibition of wine was revealed, it was prepared from five things: from wheat, barley, date, grape, honey; and wine is that which clouds the intellect; and O people, I wish Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) could have explained to us in (more) detail the laws pertaining to the inheritance of the grandfather, about one who dies leaving no issue, and some of the problems pertaining to interest
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَيَّانَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عُمَرَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، عَلَى مِنْبَرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ أَمَّا بَعْدُ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ فَإِنَّهُ نَزَلَ تَحْرِيمُ الْخَمْرِ وَهْىَ مِنْ خَمْسَةٍ مِنَ الْعِنَبِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالْعَسَلِ وَالْحِنْطَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ وَالْخَمْرُ مَا خَامَرَ الْعَقْلَ وَثَلاَثٌ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ وَدِدْتُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ عَهِدَ إِلَيْنَا فِيهِنَّ عَهْدًا نَنْتَهِي إِلَيْهِ الْجَدُّ وَالْكَلاَلَةُ وَأَبْوَابٌ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الرِّبَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, aakhbaranaa abnu iidriysa, haddathanaa aabuw hayyaana, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani abni, 'umara qaala sami'tu 'umara bna alkhattaabi, 'alaa minbari rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu aammaa ba'du aayyuhaa alnnaasu faiinnahu nazala tahriymu alkhamri wahaa min khamsaain mina al'inabi waalttamri waal'asali waalhintaai waalshha'iyri waalkhamru maa khaamara al'aqla wathalaathun aayyuhaa alnnaasu wadidtu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana 'ahida iilaynaa fiyhinna 'ahdana nantahiy iilayhi aljaddu waalkalaalaau waaabwaabun min aabwaabi alrribaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:I heard 'Umar b. Khattab delivering sermon on the pulpit ol Allah's messenger (ﷺ) and saying': Now, coming to the point, O people, there was revealed (the command pertaining to the prohibition of wine) and it was prepared (at that time) out of five things: grape, date, honey, wheat, barley, and wine is that which clouds the intellect, and, O people, I wish Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had explained to us in greater detail three things: the inheritance of the grandfather, of one who dies without leaving any issue, and some of the problems of interest
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّانَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمَا غَيْرَ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ الْعِنَبِ ‏.‏ كَمَا قَالَ ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عِيسَى الزَّبِيبِ ‏.‏ كَمَا قَالَ ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, kilaahumaa 'an aabiy hayyaana, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythihimaa ghayra aanna abna 'ulayyaaa fiy hadiythihi al'inabi ‏.‏ kamaa qaala abnu iidriysa wafiy hadiythi 'iysaa alzzabiybi ‏.‏ kamaa qaala abnu mushirin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the same authority but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ، بْنِ عُبَادٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ، يُقْسِمُ قَسَمًا إِنَّ ‏{‏ هَذَانِ خَصْمَانِ اخْتَصَمُوا فِي رَبِّهِمْ‏}‏ إِنَّهَا نَزَلَتْ فِي الَّذِينَ بَرَزُوا يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ حَمْزَةُ وَعَلِيٌّ وَعُبَيْدَةُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ وَعُتْبَةُ وَشَيْبَةُ ابْنَا رَبِيعَةَ وَالْوَلِيدُ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu zuraaraaa, haddathanaa hushaymun, 'an aabiy haashimin, 'an aabiy mijlazin, 'an qaysi, bni 'ubaadin qaala sami'tu aabaa dharrin, yuqsimu qasamana iinna ‏{‏ hadhaani khasmaani akhtasamuwa fiy rabbihim‏}‏ iinnahaa nazalat fiy alladhiyna barazuwa yawma badrin hamzaau wa'aliyyun wa'ubaydaau bnu alhaarithi wa'utbaau washaybaau abnaa rabiy'aaa waalwaliydu bnu 'utbaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr took an oath that this verse:" These two adversaries who dispute about their Lord" (xxii. 19) was revealed in connection with those who on the Day of Badr came out (of rows to fight against the non-believers and they were) Hamza, 'Ali, 'Ubaida b. Harith (from the side of the Muslims) and 'Utba and Shaiba, both of them the sons of Rabi'a and Walid b. 'Utba (from the side of the non-believers of Mecca)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ عُبَادٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ، يُقْسِمُ لَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ هَذَانِ خَصْمَانِ‏}‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ هُشَيْمٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, jamiy'ana 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiy haashimin, 'an aabiy mijlazin, 'an qaysi bni 'ubaadin, qaala sami'tu aabaa dharrin, yuqsimu lanazalat ‏{‏ hadhaani khasmaani‏}‏ bimithli hadiythi hushaymin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Dharr through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
